new_roles.title: Vice President of Quality
new_roles.description:
We are partnering with a leading global prestige beauty and skincare company to identify a
**Vice President of Quality**
to lead its North American Quality organization.

This is a high-impact executive leadership opportunity for a commercially minded quality professional who can connect quality, regulatory compliance, manufacturing excellence, and business performance within a complex, global organization.

The successful candidate will oversee Quality across North American manufacturing and distribution operations, providing leadership to a network of internal manufacturing operations and external manufacturing partners across multiple continents.

**About The Opportunity**

Reporting into senior global leadership, the Vice President of Quality will lead an organization of approximately 100 professionals, with four Directors reporting directly into the role.

The scope encompasses contract manufacturing quality, factory quality (QA, QC, laboratories, and Quality Management Systems), and quality assurance across North America, while providing technical quality leadership and guidance to teams in Canada and Brazil.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead the North American Quality organization:**
 Provide strategic direction and leadership across manufacturing, quality assurance, quality control, laboratories, and quality systems.
* **Act as the business voice of Quality:**
 Partner with commercial, brand, manufacturing, and executive stakeholders to translate quality and regulatory requirements into sound business decisions.
* **Drive regulatory and compliance excellence:**
 Ensure alignment between global quality standards and US regulatory requirements, particularly FDA OTC regulations and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
* **Oversee contract manufacturing quality:**
 Provide quality leadership and oversight across a network of approximately 30–40 contract manufacturing partners, including key strategic suppliers.
* **Strengthen organizational capabilities:**
 Develop a technically strong team, promote greater autonomy, build leadership capabilities, and establish succession depth.
* **Partner with manufacturing leadership:**
 Work closely with plant and operational leaders to balance quality expectations with production demands, providing constructive challenge and driving continuous improvement.
* **Lead through influence:**
 Build strong relationships across a global, multicultural, and matrixed organization, including teams and stakeholders outside of the direct reporting structure.
* **Prepare the organization for future growth:**
 Build the organizational structure, capabilities, and relationships necessary to support a potentially broader international Quality remit.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Extensive leadership experience in Quality within beauty, personal care, consumer health, or complex consumer goods manufacturing environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with
 **FDA OTC regulations and GMP requirements**
 .
* Proven experience leading large, multi-layered Quality organizations and developing senior leadership teams.
* Experience overseeing contract manufacturers, external manufacturing partners, and complex supplier networks.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing quality, QA, QC, laboratory operations, and Quality Management Systems.
* Commercially oriented leadership approach, with the ability to translate technical and regulatory considerations into practical business decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and operate effectively within global, matrixed organizations.
* Experience balancing quality standards, operational performance, and business priorities.
* Conversational French is considered a strong advantage.

new_roles.title: Vice President of Quality
new_roles.description:
**Vice President of Quality**

**Growing Engineering & Advanced Manufacturing Business**

**Connecticut**

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Vice President of Quality to join a growing, established engineering and manufacturing business.

This is a key leadership appointment, offering the opportunity to shape and develop the quality function, drive operational excellence and embed a proactive culture of quality across the organisation.

The business is continuing to grow and invest in its manufacturing capabilities, making this an important role in ensuring that quality systems, processes and standards evolve in line with its ambitions.

We are particularly interested in hearing from individuals with a background in precision engineering, aerospace or advanced manufacturing, where quality, technical accuracy and process control are fundamental to business performance.

**The Opportunity**

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you will take overall responsibility for the strategic direction and operational delivery of the Quality function.

A key priority will be to move quality beyond a reactive, inspection-led approach, working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Production and Supply Chain to identify the root causes of issues, implement sustainable corrective actions and prevent recurrence.

You will play a highly visible, cross-functional role, influencing how the business operates and ensuring quality is embedded at every stage of the manufacturing process.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop the Quality function, establishing a clear strategy, measurable objectives and a culture of continuous improvement.
* Drive a proactive approach to Quality Assurance, focusing on identifying the underlying causes of process and product issues rather than simply addressing the symptoms.
* Work collaboratively with Engineering, Manufacturing, Production and Supply Chain to improve process capability, product consistency and operational performance.
* Lead root cause analysis, corrective and preventative action (CAPA) and structured problem-solving initiatives.
* Oversee the Quality Management System, ensuring robust processes, compliance and readiness for internal, external and customer audits.
* Develop and monitor quality KPIs, using data and trend analysis to identify opportunities for improvement and drive accountability.
* Take ownership of supplier quality, working with key suppliers to improve standards, resolve issues and strengthen supply chain performance.
* Partner with Engineering on new product introduction, design changes and manufacturing process improvements.
* Develop, coach and lead a capable quality team, building technical expertise and accountability throughout the function.
* Work closely with the senior leadership team to ensure quality initiatives support wider business objectives, customer satisfaction and continued growth.

**The Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for a commercially aware and technically credible Quality leader who can operate strategically while remaining close enough to the manufacturing operation to understand where and why issues occur.

**You will ideally bring:**

* Significant senior-level Quality leadership experience within a precision engineering, aerospace, advanced manufacturing or similarly demanding engineering environment.
* A strong background in Quality Assurance, Quality Management Systems and manufacturing process control.
* Proven experience of leading root cause analysis and driving effective, lasting corrective actions across complex manufacturing processes.
* The ability to work cross-functionally, influencing Engineering, Operations, Production and Supply Chain teams to improve quality performance.
* A good understanding of machining, manufacturing processes, materials and engineering specifications.
* Experience with continuous improvement methodologies, statistical process control and quality performance metrics.
* Experience managing customer and supplier quality, audits and regulatory or industry compliance requirements.
* Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to develop teams and influence at all levels of an organisation.
* A relevant engineering or science degree, alongside substantial Quality Management experience, would be advantageous.

new_roles.title: Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
The Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement is the company's technical authority for how meals are made and the owner of its improvement engine. This hands-on leader combines deep manufacturing process engineering with a disciplined continuous improvement approach to make production operations more consistent, efficient, safe, and cost-effective across Mom's Meals.
 
 
The role will focus primarily on kitchen and production operations, supporting a highly automated manufacturing environment through process design, equipment performance, root cause problem solving, and structured improvement projects. The position will also support fulfillment operations by identifying automation and process opportunities that improve throughput, labor efficiency, accuracy, and customer service.
 
 
The Director partners closely with Production, Fulfillment, Supply Chain, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance, R&D, IT, and Finance to execute strategic projects and deliver measurable, sustained improvement across the enterprise. This is a player-coach role: the Director is expected to engage directly on the production floor, lead technical problem solving, and develop the engineers and improvement practitioners on the team.
 
 
**This position will travel to our other facilities 25-50% at varying times.**
**Ideally, the selected candidate will work out of one of our Production facilities (Ankeny/Grinnell, IA, Oklahoma City, OK, or North Jackson, OH) but are open to remote for the right skills and experience.**
**Benefits**
Our employees enjoy a generous package of benefits that we are thrilled to provide, and feel is part of what makes us different as an employer. We value our team members, and this is one way we can show it.
 
 
**Benefits Include**

* PTO, holiday pay and holiday of choice
* 401(k) match
* Life insurance
* Short-term disability
* Health, dental and vision insurance
* Maternity/paternity leave
* Health savings account (HSA)
* Flex spending accounts (FSA) – health and dependent

**Position Responsibilities May Include, But Not Limited To**
Process & Technical Engineering
 
 

* Serve as the company's process authority for meal production, owning process design, line layouts, standard work, and process specifications for cooking, chilling, portioning, and packaging
* Lead structured process control plans, risk assessments, and capability studies to reduce variation and improve consistency
* Drive yield, discard, and portion-control improvements through engineering-based solutions
* Partner with Production, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance and R&D teams to ensure process changes are validated, documented, and sustained on the production floor
* Reduce downtime and defects through root cause analysis and hands-on, engineering-based problem solving
* Evaluate emerging manufacturing technologies and process innovations that improve efficiency, quality, and scalability
* Ensure engineering and process solutions comply with USDA, FDA, food safety, sanitary design, and regulatory requirements

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence
 
 

* Build and lead a multi-site continuous improvement program, maintaining a prioritized project portfolio with defined savings targets validated with Finance
* Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and structured problem-solving methodologies (such as A3, DMAIC, value stream mapping, changeover reduction, and standard work)
* Drive waste reduction, productivity improvement, and labor optimization initiatives
* Evaluate operational KPIs, including OEE, yield, labor productivity, and discards, and use data analytics to prioritize improvement opportunities
* Coach kitchen and production leaders and engineers in structured problem solving, and ensure improvements are standardized and sustained
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement across operations

Kitchen & Production Engineering
 
 

* Lead engineering efforts supporting highly automated meal production operations
* Drive equipment performance, uptime, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvements
* Identify ideal equipment required to produce Mom's Meals to specification at scale, including equipment that should be replaced or decommissioned and equipment that can deliver OEE improvements and a measurable return on investment
* Partner with Production leadership and Commercialization team to identify bottlenecks and improve throughput
* Lead facility expansion projects, line installations, equipment upgrades, and process redesign initiatives

Capital & Automation Projects
 
 

* Develop and manage the engineering capital plan, prioritizing projects by safety, quality, and measurable return
* Lead project prioritization, design, budgeting, vendor selection, implementation, and startup activities
* Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget
* Manage external engineering firms, contractors, equipment suppliers, and system integrators
* Build a practical, multi-year automation roadmap focused on productivity, yield, and labor efficiency
* Establish project governance, reporting, and post-implementation performance reviews

Maintenance & Reliability Partnership
 
 

* Partner with Maintenance leadership on standards for asset management, equipment lifecycle planning, and preventative, predictive, and reliability-centered maintenance practices
* Use maintenance KPIs, including downtime, PM completion rates, equipment failure rates, and maintenance costs, to prioritize engineering and improvement work

Leadership & Team Development
 
 

* Provide coaching, mentorship, and technical leadership to process engineering, continuous improvement, and engineering personnel
* Develop future engineering leaders, improvement practitioners, and technical subject matter experts
* Promote a culture focused on safety, engagement, accountability, and operational excellence

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field
* 10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience within manufacturing, food production, and highly automated operations, including leading process engineering or continuous improvement teams
* Hands-on experience applying Lean and Six Sigma tools, with a demonstrated record of delivering quantified, sustained savings and performance gains
* Strong process engineering skills, including process design, root cause analysis, process capability, statistical analysis, and OEE and yield analytics
* Demonstrated success leading capital projects and automation implementations, including equipment installations and line upgrades
* Working knowledge of industrial automation, controls, packaging systems, and manufacturing technologies
* Knowledge of Sanitary Design Principles and Standards for food manufacturing.
* Experience leading teams in regulated manufacturing environments
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional leaders and drive enterprise-wide change

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
* Food manufacturing, packaged goods, pharmaceutical, and automated distribution experience
* Experience with Industry 4.0 technologies, predictive maintenance, and digital manufacturing tools
* Experience managing and understanding facility utility controls, including HVAC, water, and steam systems
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or advanced technical degree

**Physical Requirements**
**Company Overview**
Mom’s Meals is a home-delivered meal service providing fully prepared, refrigerated meal solutions direct to homes nationwide since 1999. We provide seniors, patients recovering post-discharge and those managing a chronic condition with tailored nutrition solutions to manage their specific needs. If you are passionate about the well-being of others and have a strong sense of community, Mom’s Meals could be the place for you! We are a family operated business looking for fun, compassionate, and friendly people who want to make a difference in the lives of others.
 
 
**EEO**
Mom’s Meals complies with all applicable federal and state non-discrimination laws. Qualified applicants shall receive consideration for employment without regards to race, religion, national origin, ancestry, color, gender, age, disability, or veteran status.

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager, Operations
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**
The Senior Operations Manager leads the machining department (approximately 60 employees) through supervisors and technical specialists. The role is accountable for safety, quality, on-time delivery, capacity utilization, productivity, and margins in a high-mix, low-volume precision CNC environment.
 
 
This is a people-and-business leadership position focused on removing barriers, driving continuous improvement, and partnering with the General Manager and Business Development to support profitable growth. Hands-on machining or CNC programming is not required.
 
 
**Key Accountabilities**

* Safety & Quality: Maintain a safety-first culture. Partner with Quality to uphold ISO standards, reduce nonconformances, and lower cost of poor quality through root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Operational Performance & Capacity: Direct production through supervisors across milling, turning, and secondary operations. Improve throughput by reducing bottlenecks, setup times, downtime, and waste. Optimize capacity planning, staffing, sequencing, and preventive maintenance.
* Delivery & Customer Execution: Own on-time delivery from order release through shipment. Ensure realistic schedules, visible priorities, and proactive recovery plans. Coordinate cross-functionally with Planning, Quality, Purchasing, and Shipping.
* Financial & Margin Management: Partner with Finance and the General Manager to protect and improve gross margin through labor productivity, material yield, scrap reduction, and disciplined cost control. Monitor job costs and provide reliable data for quoting, make/buy decisions, and capital recommendations.
* Systems & Continuous Improvement: Drive adoption, accuracy, and continuous improvement of ERP/MRP and shop-floor systems. Apply Lean tools (5S/6S, standard work, SMED, value-stream mapping, Kaizen) where they deliver measurable results. Develop practical performance dashboards and management reviews.
* People Leadership & Culture: Develop supervisors, team leads, and production personnel through coaching, clear expectations, and empowerment. Build engagement, retention, skills development, and succession. Foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Growth Partnership: Support Business Development with capacity assessments, customer meetings, and opportunity qualification to profitably fill available machine capacity.

**Key Performance Measures**

* Safety performance
* On-time delivery and schedule adherence
* Throughput, labor productivity, setup time, and unplanned downtime
* Capacity utilization and available capacity for new work
* Gross margin, job-cost variance, and scrap/rework costs
* ERP/MRP data accuracy and timely reporting
* Employee engagement, retention, and internal development
* Nonconformance trends and cost of quality

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience leading manufacturing teams or operations departments, preferably in CNC machining, high-mix/low-volume contract manufacturing, or precision manufacturing. Hands-on machinist or programming experience is not required.
* Demonstrated improvements in productivity, on-time delivery, profitability, and operational performance, supported by measurable results.
* Experience implementing or improving ERP/MRP systems, production scheduling, job costing, and KPI reporting.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, business acumen, change management, and cross-functional communication skills.
* Practical understanding of capacity, cost drivers, scheduling, Lean methods, and ISO-based quality systems.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or business preferred; equivalent relevant leadership experience will be considered.

**Role Alignment**
This role manages the machining department through its supervisors and technical staff, with accountability for people development, operational performance, and continuous improvement. The Senior Operations Manager partners with the General Manager on business priorities, financial objectives, and capital recommendations, and with Business Development on customer relationships and growth.
 
 
The position does not require personally operating or programming CNC equipment. Final authority for pricing, hiring, capital spending, and related decisions will be defined by company leadership.
 
 
**Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled**
This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Asia Manufacturing Strategy & Operations
new_roles.description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Senior Manager, Global Innovation, oversees performance management, operational excellence, and strategic execution for manufacturing entities across Asia, including Vietnam, China, and South Korea. Serves as a key liaison between headquarters and regional production sites, driving data‑driven decision‑making, productivity improvements, and process standardization.
 
 
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Performance Management & Financial Oversight
* Monitor and evaluate the operational and financial performance of manufacturing subsidiaries in Asia
* Develop and manage KPIs
* Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with regional leadership
* Identify performance gaps and implement corrective action plans
* Strategic Planning & Execution
* Formulate mid- to long-term manufacturing and supply chain strategies aligned with global business objectives
* Support capacity planning, cost optimization, and footprint strategy (e.g., China+1, nearshoring)
* Conduct market and operational feasibility analysis for new investments or expansions
* Operational Excellence & Process Improvement
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across production sites (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen)
* Standardize processes and implement best practices across regions
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Procurement, Logistics, Quality, R&D) to improve end-to-end efficiency
* HQ–Regional Coordination
* Act as the primary liaison between HQ and Asia manufacturing teams
* Ensure alignment on corporate policies, reporting standards, and operational priorities
* Facilitate communication, issue resolution, and project execution across time zones
* Data Analytics & Reporting
* Build and maintain dashboards and reporting systems for real-time performance tracking
* Analyze large datasets to generate actionable insights and executive-level reports
* Support digital transformation initiatives (ERP, MES, data integration)

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or related field (MBA preferred)
* 7–10+ years of experience in manufacturing, supply chain, or operations strategy roles
* Proven experience managing or overseeing operations in Asia (Vietnam, China, Korea preferred)
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, Power BI/Tableau, or similar tools
* Deep understanding of manufacturing KPIs and continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma)
* Experience working in a global, matrixed organization

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.)
* Multilingual capability (Korean, Chinese, or Vietnamese is a plus)
* Strong project management and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to travel internationally (20–40%)

**Benefits**

* Premium Medical Insurance Coverage
* 401(k) Savings Plan
* Paid Time Off (PTO) based on seniority
* Paid Holidays

**Additional Workplace Offerings (subject To Change Or Eligibility.)**

* Annual Bonus Plan
* Onsite Employee Fitness Center with Indoor Racquetball Court and Yoga Room
* Summer Fridays
* Complimentary Gourmet Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner
* Relocation Support for New Hires
* Work Anniversary Recognitions
* Congratulatory & Condolence Gifts
* Employee Referral Bonus Program
* License/Certification Reimbursements
* Corporate Employee Discounts
* Visa Sponsorships (100% paid by the company) i.e., New H-1B, H-1B Transfer, O-1, and Green Card
* Commuter Support (Shuttle Bus Program and EZPass Support)
* Vehicle Perks

**Qualification(s)**
**Education(s):**
Bachelor of Science (B.S) (Required)
 
 
**Work Experience**
Experience Range V: +13 years of relevant experience or industry exposure in a related field
 
 
**Skill(s)**
Lean Process Improvements, Manufacturing, Operational Strategies, Six Sigma Framework, Supply Chain
 
 
**Language(s)**
English, Korean
 
 
**Certification(s)**
Not Applicable
 
 
The anticipated compensation range is
 
 
91,000.00 - 172,000.00 USD Annual
 
 
Actual compensation will be determined based on various factors including qualifications, education, experience, and location. The pay range is subject to change at any time dependent on a variety of internal and external factors.
 
 
Kiss Nail Products, Inc., KDC GA Corp., Ivy Enterprises, Inc., AST Systems, LLC, Red Beauty, Inc., or Dae Do, Inc. (collectively, the “Company”) is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Production Planning & Logistics – Development Programs (R5252)
new_roles.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.
 
 
**Job Description**
Shield AI is seeking a highly driven Sr. Manager Materials Planning & Logistics to lead supply planning, material readiness, production planning, and logistics execution for next-generation autonomous aircraft development programs and a new greenfield manufacturing facility. This leadership role is accountable for establishing the people, processes, systems, and infrastructure required to support rapid product development, new product introduction, and the transition to scalable rate production.
 
 
The ideal candidate combines strong operational leadership with hands-on execution, thrives in fast-paced environments, and has experience building manufacturing and supply chain capabilities from the ground up. You will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Program Management, Quality, Procurement, and Operations teams.
 
 
**What You'll Do**
Development Program Materials Planning
 
 

* Own the materials planning, production control, inventory, warehousing, and logistics strategy.
* Partner with Engineering, Program Management, and Procurement to develop and maintain accurate build plans that are aligned with program milestones.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators for schedule attainment, material availability, shortage reduction, inventory health, work-order execution, and planning accuracy.
* Identify long-lead material risks and implement mitigation strategies to protect schedule.
* Oversee the development and execution of material recovery plans.
* Drive engineering change management processes to support rapid development and ECO implementation.
* Develop planning models that support rapid prototyping, design iteration, and low-rate initial production activities.
* Support executive-level program and operations reviews by clearly communicating material status, risks, business impacts, and required decisions.

Greenfield Facility Build & Operational Readiness
 
 

* Lead planning and logistics readiness activities for a new manufacturing facility.
* Design and implement warehouse, stockroom, and material flow processes from receiving through point-of-use consumption.
* Establish inventory control procedures, material storage standards, and transaction discipline.
* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and Facilities teams to optimize material movement and operational efficiency.

Team Leadership
 
 

* Create a culture focused on accountability, operational excellence, continuous improvement, and mission execution.
* Establish standard work and training programs.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration to solve complex challenges.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 7+ years of experience in materials planning, inventory management, or supply chain operations.
* Experience supporting complex hardware development programs in aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or advanced manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling material planning and inventory management processes.
* Strong understanding of MRP/ERP systems and supply chain planning methodologies.
* Experience managing material readiness for new product introduction (NPI) and engineering development programs.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly dynamic environment with evolving priorities.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain/maintain a security clearance

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting greenfield manufacturing facility launches or major facility expansions.
* Aerospace, defense, unmanned systems, or advanced technology manufacturing experience.
* Experience with Oracle, SAP, Costpoint, or similar ERP platforms.
* APICS/ASCM certifications (CPIM, CSCP) or equivalent.
* Familiarity with ITAR, EAR, DFARS, and government contracting requirements.
* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or operational excellence experience.
* Experience supporting production ramp and transition from development to rate manufacturing.

**Why Shield AI**
At Shield AI, you'll help build technology that matters. You'll work alongside world-class engineers, operators, and innovators solving some of the most challenging problems in autonomy and national security. This is a unique opportunity to shape the foundation of a rapidly growing aerospace and defense company while helping bring revolutionary autonomous systems into operational service.
 
 
#LD
 
 
**Full-time Regular Employee Offer Package**
Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity
 
 
**Temporary Employee Offer Package**
Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment)
 
 
Salary compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location. All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check. Military fellows and part-time employees are not eligible for benefits. Please speak to your talent acquisition representative for more information.
 
 
###
 
 
Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
 
 
Compensation Range: $167,328 - $250,992

new_roles.title: Senior Manager of Operations
new_roles.description:
**Senior Manager of Operations - Austin, TX**

**DESCRIPTION:**

We’re seeking a hands-on Sr. Operations Manager with experience scaling silicon-based products in a semiconductor company. This player-coach role owns the operational path from foundry and wafer production through test, backend processing, and manufacturing. You’ll qualify and manage manufacturing vendors, establish and strengthen quality-control measures, and drive consistent quality, yield, cost, and delivery as production grows.

Experience with RFID inlay production is especially relevant.

**What you’ll do:**

* Own foundry relationships from negotiation through production execution, and scale wafer level production.
* Manage wafer-test facility relationships; evaluate and qualify test partners, and select test equipment to optimize cost, quality, and throughput.
* Lead test development, wafer backend operations, yield improvement, reliability, and failure analysis.
* Qualify and manage manufacturing vendors, including overseeing end-to-end inlay production and its ramp to volume.
* Establish and improve quality-control measures, operating procedures, and RMA processes.
* Monitor supplier quality, conduct supply-chain audits, and resolve manufacturing, quality, and delivery issues.
* Establish and improve ERP/MRP processes, WIP tracking, inventory planning, and production controls.
* Develop cost models, negotiate contracts, and drive improvements in cost, quality, and delivery.
* Manage one direct report and coordinate work across four internal engineers and executive stakeholders, including the CEO.

**What you’ll bring:**

* BSEE or equivalent practical experience.
* 7–10 years of operations, manufacturing, or related experience in a semiconductor company.
* Experience with RFID inlay manufacturing is a plus.
* Hands-on experience with silicon-based products and semiconductor manufacturing operations.
* Experience scaling products from wafer fabrication and test through backend processing and volume production.
* Experience working with foundries, wafer-test facilities, and manufacturing vendors.
* Familiarity with yield optimization, reliability, quality assurance, supplier audits, failure analysis, ERP/MRP systems, WIP tracking, and inventory planning.
* Strong communication, coordination, and negotiation skills, with a practical, roll-up-your sleeves approach.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Engineering Programs
new_roles.description:
Are you interested in being part of an innovative team that supports Westinghouse's mission to provide clean energy solutions? At Westinghouse, we recognize that our employees are our most valuable asset and we seek to identify, attract and recruit the most qualified talent while recognizing and encouraging the value of diversity in the global workplace.
 
 
**About The Role**
As a Senior Manager of MFG Engineering Programs in our New Product Introduction group, you will be responsible and accountable to lead and deliver global nuclear fuel manufacturing project execution across Westinghouse Electric Corporation (WEC) fuel manufacturing facilities in the US, UK & Sweden operations. You will be deployed to guide progress and execution of multiple projects within our organization, based on the program needs. The Sr Manager owns the global manufacturing scope of new product introduction and is accountable to lead project execution to delivery in-full, without complaint products to our customers while meeting safety and financial goals. This position will guide interaction between Fuel Engineering, Nuclear Fuel Project Managers, Product Delivery & Commercial Managers, Product Management, Supply Chain, SIOP, Plant Manufacturing Managers, Global Quality, and Supplier or customer teams. It will also coordinate on project deliverables, issues, and resolution. Program budget accountability ranges from $1M - $20M.
 
 
You will report to the Director of New Product Introduction and support the role remotely with 25 - 35% travel between global manufacturing facilities.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Comprehend entire program scope, such as commercial, licensing, regulatory and initiate appropriate scope within the manufacturing program scope.
* Support project task-based schedules and track/report milestone progress against the program management plan.
* Deploy strategies for optimizing and streamlining legacy fuel manufacturing operations in partnership with manufacturing sites and functional leads.
* Analyze existing processes and identify value-added and non-value-added activities to solve design challenges.
* Manage project risks and opportunities to closure in partnership with functional leads and Program Managers. Identify issues, propose solutions and lead recovery plans to closure.
* Implement within project schedule and budget, tracking expenses and identifying cost-savings opportunities. Communicate with partners, providing updates on project milestones, risks, critical escalations and issues.
* Present strategic project reports, status updates, and performance metrics to senior leadership and important partners.
* Identify areas of improvement or gaps in current processes and develop strategies to promote efficiency and productivity in new product and process introduction.
* Perform as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support project teams in new product and process development such as APQP and PPAP industry standards.
* Compare actual performance against planned performance to identify variances and help manage tasks on project planning.
* Collaborate with program team members and departments to establish plans and schedules that allocate resources to best achieve program requirements and service internal and external client or customer needs.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or related field.
* 10 -15 years related experience in Nuclear/ Automotive/ Heavy Engineering/ Metals Industry / Manufacturing / Assembly.
* Experience with project management and new product introduction into manufacturing.
* Analytical capabilities to identify critical schedule paths and improve engineering / supply chain timelines.
* Demonstrated skills in internal operational partner relationship management.
* Advance level PMI certification in Project Management.
* Experience of Engineering Component Manufacturing systems.
* Experience with engineering product development including design phases, manufacturing processes and global supply chain management.
* Familiarization with Kaizen, Lean Operations, FMEA's, DMAIC, DFMAs, POCA cycles.
* Familiarization with Microsoft Project, P6 or other scheduling software.

We are committed to transparency and equity in all of our people practices. The base salary range for this position, which is dependent upon experience, qualifications and skills, is estimated to be $144,000 to $180,000 per year.
 
 
**Why Westinghouse?**
**Benefits**
**Our benefits package is tailored to meet the diverse needs of our employees, while also promoting wellness and career growth. The following are representative of what we offer:**

* Comprehensive Medical benefits which could include medical, dental, vision, prescription coverage and Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions options
* Wellness Programs designed to support employees in maintaining their health and well-being including Employee Assistance Program providing support for our employees and their household members
* 401(k) with Company Match Contributions to support employees' retirement
* Paid Vacations and Company Holidays
* Opportunities for Flexible Work Arrangements to promote work-life balance
* Educational Reimbursement and Comprehensive Career Programs to help employees grow in their careers
* Global Recognition and Service Programs to celebrate employee accomplishments and service
* Employee Referral Program

Westinghouse Electric Company Is The Global Nuclear Energy Industry's First Choice For Safe, Clean, And Efficient Energy Solutions. We Enable Our Delivery Of This Vision By Living Our Value System
 
 

* Safety and Quality
* Integrity and Trust
* Customer Focus and Innovation
* Speed and Passion to Win
* Teamwork and Accountability

**While our Global Headquarters are located in Cranberry Township, PA, we have over 11,000 employees working at locations in 19 different countries. You can learn more by visiting**
http://www.westinghousenuclear.com .
 
 
Westinghouse is an Equal Opportunity Employer including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities

new_roles.description:
**About us:**
At Plexus, our vision is to help create the products that build a better world. Driven by a passion for excellence, we partner with leading Aerospace/Defense, Healthcare/Life Sciences and Industrial companies to design, manufacture and service some of the world’s most transformative products, including advanced surgical systems, diagnostic instruments, healthcare imaging equipment, mission critical aerospace systems, and electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions. Visit Plexus.com to learn more about our unwavering commitment to our vision.
 
 
**When we invest in our people, we invest in building a better world.**
With a vision rooted in the wellbeing and inclusive engagement of our team members, our customers, their end users and our communities, people are the heart of what we do and who we are. It is our values that unite us and guide us in everything that we do, including how we operate, behave and interact to foster a workplace where every team member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best.
 
 
Our values include: Growing our People, Building Belonging, Innovating Responsibly, Delivering Excellence and Creating Customer Success.
 
 
As a team member, you will engage in impactful work through global collaboration and the use of emerging technologies, join an inclusive culture where every team member is valued and working toward a greater purpose, and be empowered to reach your full potential through various development programs designed to accelerate your growth.
 
 
Plexus offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support team members' wellbeing, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, retirement savings, and opportunities for professional development. We also prioritize work-life balance and offer a variety of perks to enhance the team member experience. For more information, visit our US benefits website at usbenefits.plexus.com. Our commitment to pay range transparency fosters an equitable workplace, where everyone can feel valued. The annual compensation range for this position is stated below. The salary offered within this range will be based upon the geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level. Salary Range:
 
 
$132,500.00 - $198,700.00
 
 
**Purpose Statement:**
To provide leadership and direction to the Manufacturing Engineering team(s) from a functional perspective. Manage the Manufacturing Engineering function in line with functional specific strategies, process and systems development, people development, employee relations, plant level metrics.
 
 
**Key Job Accountabilities**

* Lead manufacturing-engineering excellence by collaborating with various functional leads to ensure engineering capability meets or exceeds manufacturing standards for quality product delivery.
* Support Program Management initiatives and activities to meet or exceed customer expectations.
* Lead process/product/equipment engineering activities in compliance with Plexus Core Values to meet industry standards, regulatory and customer requirements.
* Provide technical leadership to site operations, establish a technology roadmap, and collaborate with corporate and regional technical teams to achieve lower costs and higher manufacturing returns.
* Responsible to exemplify and hold their team accountable to demonstrating the Plexus Core Values. Leader will focus on evaluating potential, driving succession planning, and ensuring their employees receive the development and coaching required to realize their full potential.

**Education/Experience Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree with 8 or more years of related experience is preferred. An equivalent combination of education and/or experience will be considered.
* Proven leadership skills and management experience.

*This document does not represent a contract of employment and is not intended to capture every possible assignment the incumbent could be asked to perform.*
We are pleased to provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities or special requirements. If you need an application accommodation, please contact us by email at GHQ.TA@plexus.com. Please include your contact information and clearly describe how we can help you. This email is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.
 
 
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
 
 
Some offers of employment are contingent upon successfully passing a drug screen and/or background check.

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager, Production Engineering, Solar Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**What To Expect**
Tesla is seeking a Senior Production Engineering Manager to lead both Equipment and Process engineering efforts for crystalline silicon manufacturing at a massive 100 GW scale. You will help deploy solar manufacturing from raw materials in a new greenfield facility. Depending on experience, this role may support Ingot, Wafer, or Cell manufacturing. This role owns the engineering strategy, process robustness, and multi-shift performance across all operations. You will build and mentor a high-performing team of Managers, engineers, and technical staff; set OEE targets; and drive yield, quality, and throughput from launch through high-volume manufacturing. This is a hands-on senior leadership role for someone who can roll up their sleeves, grow people, and deliver results in a demanding, fast-paced environment. This role is core to Tesla's mission of accelerating the world's transition to amazing abundance.
 
 
**What You'll Do**- Lead and develop Managers, engineers, and technical staff to achieve engineering goals
- During greenfield launch and ramp, own the production engineering plan for assigned processes (e.g., Czochralski crystal pulling, diamond wire saw slicing, texturing, wafer cleaning, thin film deposition, screen printing, and laser operations) - from readiness through stable high-volume performance
- Set and drive data-driven targets for OEE, yield, cycle time, scrap, and process capability; install the metrics, reviews, and escalation rhythms that Associate Managers and engineers run daily
- Own process control strategy for the area - control plans, PFMEA, process windows, and MES/data systems - so production is robust, repeatable, and audit-ready
- Lead structured problem-solving and continuous improvement (DOE, root cause analysis, lean) on chronic yield, quality, and equipment-effectiveness losses
- Partner with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Design, Production, and NPI teams on new product/process introductions, equipment upgrades, and change control, aligning downtime windows and technical priorities with operations
- Ensure safety and environmental standards on the floor, including incident leadership support, hazard reduction, and strong 5S/operating discipline across the teams you lead
**What You'll Bring**- Degree in Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or equivalent experience
- 12+ years in high-volume manufacturing with at least 9 years leading engineering and/or operations teams; semiconductor, solar ingot/wafer/cell, battery, or related precision manufacturing strongly preferred
- Proven track record of ramping complex automated processes from pilot/launch to volume, delivering yield, OEE, and quality outcomes through other leaders - not only as an individual contributor
- Hands-on fluency with lean manufacturing, process control, PFMEA/control plans, DOE, and root cause methods; strong use of production data, MES, and metrics storytelling for decision-making
- Familiarity with crystalline silicon process families such as crystal pulling, wafering, wet process/texturing/cleaning, deposition, screen printing, and laser operations
- Exceptional leadership and communication skills: hiring, coaching, and developing diverse teams in a 24/7 environment, with confidence presenting to senior leadership and aligning cross-functional partners
- Capability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally; travel will vary based on launch timing: more frequently during build, less during HVM and sustaining
, Tesla

new_roles.title: Director, Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
**Job Description**
The Director, Continuous Improvement leads the Supply Chain-wide capability for identifying, prioritizing, enabling, and sustaining improvements that increase business performance and organizational effectiveness across functions and end-to-end processes. This role establishes a culture of continuous improvement, advances operational and business process excellence, and enables measurable improvements in productivity, cost, quality, service, and capacity.
 
 
Working closely with cross-functional Supply Chain leaders, this position standardizes processes, uses data and insights to prioritize opportunities, and implements sustainable solutions aligned with strategic objectives. The Director maintains a strong connection to frontline operations by working directly in Supply Chain Centers and other functional environments to understand processes firsthand and translate observations into meaningful improvements.
 
 
**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive Continuous Improvement strategy and multi-year roadmap aligned with Supply Chain priorities, and advise Supply Chain leadership on opportunities that improve productivity, efficiency, cost, service, quality, capacity, and organizational effectiveness.
* Lead the deployment of consistent Continuous Improvement methodologies, tools, governance, performance expectations, and resource prioritization across Supply Chain functions.
* Work directly with Supply Chain Centers and functional teams to observe work at the point of execution, identify process variation and non-value-added activities, and implement standardized processes, operating practices, management systems, standard work, and process controls.
* Lead cross-functional transformation and productivity initiatives, including process redesign, technology-enabled improvement, automation, and new ways of working, in partnership with functional leaders, the PMO, Finance, and other stakeholders.
* Establish measurable outcomes, baselines, KPI definitions, reporting standards, dashboards, and processes for tracking, validating, and sustaining financial benefits, productivity improvements, and business value.
* Build organizational Continuous Improvement capability through training, coaching, structured problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and the development of CI team members and functional leaders.
* Lead change management and cross-functional alignment, manage risks and barriers, strengthen process integration, and communicate priorities, progress, results, and recommendations to Supply Chain leadership and key stakeholders.

**What You’ll Bring**
In addition to the technical and functional requirements of this role, successful candidates demonstrate Domino's Hungry for MORE Ways of Working:
 
 
Be Curious
 
 

* Seeks clarity, asks thoughtful questions, and uncovers root causes to solve problems effectively.
* Actively pursues learning opportunities, applies feedback, and continuously develops new skills.

Connect the Dots
 
 

* Uses information and insights to identify opportunities and drive informed decisions.
* Builds strong partnerships across teams and considers the broader organizational impact of decisions.

Aim High
 
 

* Sets ambitious goals, challenges the status quo, and focuses on work that drives meaningful business results.
* Uses feedback and data to continuously improve performance and outcomes.

Shift Fast
 
 

* Adapts quickly to changing priorities and business needs while maintaining focus on results.
* Demonstrates resilience, sound judgment, and the ability to learn from setbacks.

Deliver More
 
 

* Takes ownership, executes with discipline, and consistently produces measurable results.
* Identifies opportunities to create additional value for customers, team members, and the business.

Leadership Expectations
 
 

* Builds and develops high-performing teams aligned to Domino’s Ways of Working.
* Creates accountability, fosters collaboration, and delivers results through others.
* Leads confidently through change while maintaining team engagement and performance.
* Demonstrates enterprise thinking and drives cross-functional alignment to achieve business goals.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing, or a related discipline; an advanced degree or MBA is preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Continuous Improvement, Supply Chain, business transformation, operational excellence, or related disciplines, including demonstrated leadership experience in complex, cross-functional organizations.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing Continuous Improvement strategies and delivering measurable business results across multiple functions or complex organizations.
* Strong knowledge and practical application of Lean Six Sigma, structured problem-solving, process optimization, standardization, and change management methodologies.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional improvement initiatives, influence stakeholders, and drive organizational change without direct authority.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience leading Continuous Improvement initiatives in manufacturing, distribution, logistics, or other complex operational environments, including the ability to engage frontline employees, site leaders, and senior executives to diagnose issues, implement solutions, and deliver measurable results.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including experience identifying, quantifying, and validating productivity improvements, cost savings, and business value.
* Well-developed team building and influencing skills, unquestioned integrity, and the experience and confidence to work effectively across multiple functions and levels of the organization.
* Experience developing performance management frameworks, leveraging data analytics, and translating insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to build organizational capability through coaching, talent development, and deployment of Continuous Improvement methodologies.
* Strong strategic thinking, communication, collaboration, and executive presentation skills.
* Experience managing complex improvement portfolios, prioritizing competing business needs, and delivering sustainable outcomes.
* Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent demonstrated Continuous Improvement expertise is preferred.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally, including Canada, as business needs require. Expected travel is up to 50%

Additional Information
 
 
Benefits:
 
 

* Paid Holidays and Vacation
* Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment
* No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents
* Childcare tuition discounts
* No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs
* Fertility benefits
* Adoption assistance
* 401k matching contributions
* 15% off the purchase price of stock
* Company bonus

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

new_roles.title: Director, Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Job Description**
**Company Overview**
Vertex is a global biotechnology company focused on investing in scientific innovation to create transformative medicines for people with serious diseases. Across our organization, we work with urgency, rigor, and collaboration to deliver therapies that improve patient outcomes and create long-term value.
 
 
**General Summary**
The Operational Excellence team serves as the process improvement and performance enablement backbone of CMTO, providing the improvement discipline, management systems, and change capabilities required to run, grow, and optimize Vertex’s commercial manufacturing network.
 
 
The Director, Operational Excellence leads the development and execution of CMTO’s Operational Excellence strategy and improvement portfolio. The role identifies and prioritizes performance improvement opportunities, leads structured problem-solving and transformation initiatives, and ensures improvements are implemented and sustained through effective change management, standard work, performance monitoring, and leadership accountability.
 
 
The Director also leads and develops the Operational Excellence team, building organizational capability, setting priorities, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability. The role partners closely with Business Analytics, Network Performance, Manufacturing Operations, MS&T, Business Operations Leads, Quality, Supply Chain, and Finance to use performance insights to identify improvement priorities and deliver measurable business outcomes.
 
 
**Key Duties And Responsibilities**

* Operational Excellence Strategy & Initiative Execution
* Contribute to setting CMTO's operational excellence strategy, priorities, and success measures, aligned to enterprise and functional priorities
* Identify, prioritize, and drive execution of a portfolio of commercial manufacturing improvement and transformation initiatives — partnering with sites and functions while avoiding ownership of routine operations
* Lead initiatives targeting lead-time reduction, launch optimization, yield, and manufacturing success-rate improvements and COGM reduction through structured problem definition, root-cause analysis, options analysis, and ROI calculation
* Lead Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, and structured problem-solving initiatives across technical and business processes
* Develop clear business cases, recommendations, and implementation plans for Operational Excellence initiatives, including expected benefits, resource requirements, risks, and measures of success.
* Manage and Lead the Operational Excellence Team
* Establish and communicate a clear vision, mission, and strategic direction for the Operational Excellence team, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and stakeholder expectations
* Partner with senior leadership to define team priorities, continuously reassessing and adjusting focus based on evolving business needs, operational risks, and strategic objectives
* Set clear performance expectations, goals, and development plans for team members; monitor progress, provide timely feedback, and hold the team accountable for results
* Remove organizational barriers and resolve escalated issues that impede team performance or delivery of key initiatives
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, innovation, and accountability by coaching and mentoring team members in problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills
* Build organizational capability by identifying skill gaps, developing talent, and implementing training and succession plans that strengthen Operational Excellence competencies
* Communicate team objectives, progress, achievements, risks, and resource needs to senior leadership and key stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment across organization
* Promote cross-functional collaboration and strong stakeholder relationships to enable successful execution of Operational Excellence initiatives and sustainable business improvements
* Continuous Improvement & Change Execution
* Embed structured problem-solving, continuous improvement, and change execution into CMTO governance and operating rhythms, using performance insights provided by Business Analytics, Network Performance, and functional teams.
* Ensure improvements are implemented and sustained through effective change management, standard work, control plans, performance monitoring, and clear process ownership.
* Identify and deploy digital tools, automation, and process solutions that improve operational performance and the scalability of Operational Excellence practices.
* Community of Practice & Capability Building
* Operate as a community-of-practice leader for manufacturing operational excellence across internal manufacturing and supply chain, driving common standards, methods, and ways of working
* Mentor teams on Lean methods, structured problem-solving, and continuous improvement practices, and benchmark industry best practices to inform innovative approaches

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Strong leadership, communication, collaboration, and team building
* Proven ability to motivate teams and build team unity
* Demonstrated success implementing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, FMEA, Hoshin Kanri, and Change Management methodologies in GMP environments
* Proven experience leading improvement initiatives targeting lead-time reduction, launch optimization, yield improvement and COGM/COGs reduction
* Experience using operational data and performance insights to identify, prioritize, and measure improvement opportunities.
* Hands-on proficiency in data analysis, root-cause analysis, process analysis, and structured problem-solving
* Ability to quantify the operational and financial benefits of improvement initiatives and communicate clear recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Experience implementing and sustaining performance management systems, visual management, Standard Work, and Leader Standard Work.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; experience with process mapping, statistical analysis, and Lean Six Sigma tools preferred.
* Ability to translate complex operational problems into clear improvement priorities, recommendations, and implementation plans.
* Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed environment with strong role clarity, partnering across Network Performance, Business Operations, Manufacturing Operations, MS&T, Finance, and Strategic Sourcing

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Life Sciences, Business, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
* Typically requires 8–12 years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, regulated manufacturing, supply chain, MS&T, Operational Excellence, or business transformation environments.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading Operational Excellence, transformation, continuous improvement, or complex process-improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt required

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.
 
 
**Pay Range**
$181,900 - $272,900
 
 
**Disclosure Statement**
The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.
 
 
At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.
 
 
**Flex Designation**
Hybrid-Eligible Or On-Site Eligible
 
 
**Flex Eligibility Status**
In this Hybrid-Eligible role, you can choose to be designated as:
 
 

* Hybrid: work remotely up to two days per week; or select
* On-Site: work five days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility.

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.
 
 
**Company Information**
Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation.
 
 
Vertex is committed to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Vertex is an E-Verify Employer in the United States. Vertex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.
 
 
Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should make a request to the recruiter or hiring manager, or contact Talent Acquisition at ApplicationAssistance@vrtx.com

new_roles.title: DIRECTOR OF HEALTHCARE QUALITY
new_roles.description:
**JOB SUMMARY:** Within the framework of the objectives and policies established by the Board of Directors of Franklin Primary Health Center, Inc., organizes and coordinates activities related to Healthcare Quality among all Franklin Primary Health Center’s clinical departments including Primary Care, Oral Health, Behavioral Health, Ryan White program, laboratory, performance improvement, etc. Plans and coordinates performance improvement activities in collaboration with the Deputy Director of Healthcare Quality Chief Medical Officer, Director of Nursing, Deputy Chief Operations Officer, Director of Behavioral Health, and Performance Improvement Manager. Participates in planning and policy formulation, with particular reference to the role, functions, and operations of the Center's clinical quality and performance improvement activities.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Coordinate and monitor clinical quality activities through the initiation of a clinical quality work plan that encompasses all clinical areas. Reports quarterly on the progress of the work plan to Chief Medical Officer. Coordinates an annual evaluation and update of the quality work plan.
* Works as a liaison between Franklin and other entities in matters pertaining to clinical quality and performance.
* Assists the Chief Medical Officer by working with all areas of clinical services to improve efficiency, communication and collaboration.
* Ensures compliance to accreditation standards, other regulatory standards, quality and initiatives.
* Coordinates the peer review process.
* Provides quality indicator analysis for the physician’s quality incentive program.
* Monitors and keeps abreast of any changes or trends in the healthcare quality area.
* Addresses through the appropriate channels any potential risk and safety issues identified through clinical quality activities.
* Publishes and monitors standards of care for the providers and the nursing department.
* Monitors the provision of quality patient care through the Chief Medical Officer and the Director of Nursing with data from Azara and EHR.
* Evaluates all clinical services and consults with Chief Medical Officer and Quality Committee.
* Supervises the Performance Improvement functions of the Performance Improvement Department.
* Develops and implements standards, goals and initiatives for the Performance Improvement department in coordination with the Deputy Director of Healthcare Quality, Performance Improvement Manager and Chief Medical Officer.
* Responsible for developing, administering, and managing the Center’s performance improvement plan.
* Provides educational support to all FPHC departments with regard to performance improvement
* Monitors and ensures Joint Commission, NCQA and OSV standards of compliance on an ongoing basis, maintaining a constant state of readiness for survey
* Reviews all clinical indicators on a regular basis including but not limited to UDS Quality Measures and makes recommendations as needed to ensure the department’s performance improvement activities are effective.
* Review Performance data presented by PI committee and identify opportunities for improvement and presents findings quarterly to Senior Management.
* Actively participates and/or facilitates committees such as: Performance Improvement, Safety and Infection Control.
* Other duties at the discretion of the Chief Medical Officer.

**ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Maintains current Alabama Nursing License and board certification. Remains abreast of current employee health practices and guidelines through continuing education classes, journals and professional organizations.
* Attends continuing education classes/webinars related to infection control practices, monitoring and surveillance of infectious disease processes within the organization.
* Attends seminars and continuing education related to Healthcare Quality trends and initiatives.
* Maintains webinars confidentiality.
* Observes and supports Center policies.
* Is prompt and efficient with minimal absences.

**CUSTOMER SATISFACTION REQUIREMENTS:** Must provide the very best customer satisfaction to staff, visitors, guests, and patients at all time in a professional and courteous manner. Provide assistance in resolving customers’ problems relating to employee services. Coordinates efforts and interfaces with other departments to resolve complaints and patient care deficiencies.

**PERFORMANCE STANDARDS:** Performance will be evaluated by the Chief Medical Officer annually wherein an overall satisfactory rating is considered as a minimum acceptable level of performance.

**HEALTH AND SAFETY REQUIREMENTS:** The health and safety requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

* Must adhere to safety regulations, personnel policies and procedures.
* Safety and Hazard Communication training update is required annually.
* Knowledgeable of OSHA and CLIA requirements to assure compliance.
* Maintain yearly health maintenance by obtaining TB skin testing and completion of the hepatitis series.

**PRIVACY RULE COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS:**

* Adheres to Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA Privacy Rule) policies and procedures.
* Must successfully complete Privacy Rule compliance training annually or as revisions are made to the policies and procedures.
* Must comply with Privacy Rule guidelines by learning to protect FPHC patient’s medical privacy.
* Must comply with Privacy Rule guidelines by appropriately maintaining our patient information in compliance with national standards.
* Must comply with Privacy Rule guidelines by providing appropriate security of FPHC patient records.

**PROTECTED HEALTH INFORMATION (PHI) ACCESS: RESTRICTED-** For purposes of HIPAA Compliance, there are 4 workforce categories, which define the level of access to PHI that is granted to the incumbent. This position is classified as **PRIMARY PROVIDERS** and therefore granted **UNRESTRICED access**- for the purpose of providing patient care; **RESTRICTED** access for other uses and disclosures, to be defined according to the purpose for which use or disclosure is intended. Use and disclosure must be in accordance with applicable privacy policies and procedures.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE: Minimum of Bachelor’s Degree and 5 years’ experience working with Quality Management (QM) in a healthcare setting or 5 or more years’ demonstrated management and supervisory skills in a healthcare setting. Possess strong managerial, administrative, and effective communication skills. Nursing licensed and/or certified professional healthcare quality (CPHQ) in the state of Alabama preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES: Demonstrated clinical competence. Demonstrate appropriate conduct, grooming and sound judgment. Demonstrated ability to work cooperatively and communicate effectively. Good health and consistent attendance. Membership and participation in AL Board of Nursing Association. Possess the ability to delegate duties effectively and efficiently. Ability to read, analyze and interpret clinical data, quality measures, and governmental regulations. Possess ability to write professional reports, letters and procedural manuals. Ability to present information and respond to questions from diverse professional and community groups effectively.

CERTIFICATION, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS: State of Alabama Registered Nurses License; CPR certification; Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) certification preferred

**PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS:** Requires working under stressful conditions or working irregular hours. Must be able to express ideas clearly and concisely; and exercise balanced judgment in evaluating situations and making decisions. Possess strong oral and written communication skills. Knowledge of the professional nursing theory and practice to direct, give, and evaluate patient care processes for the department. Knowledge
