new_roles.description:
### **Summary**

The Production Manager oversees the operations of the entire production facility (excluding purchasing, personnel, and non-production functions), with a focus on the Converting department. This role ensures adherence to company policies and procedures while driving optimal operational performance. The manager directly supervises Converting employees and supervisors.

**Perks of Pratt:**

* Medical/Dental/Vision Plans
* Short Term/Long Term Disability
* Supplemental Life Insurance Plans
* Child Bearing/Parental Leave
* 401K Plan with Company Match
* Paid Holidays/Paid Vacation
* Uniforms/Safety Shoes/Prescription Safety Glasses
* Healthy Lifestyles Program/ Virgin Pulse Fitness Tracker
* $500.0/Year Gym Membership Reimbursement100% Tuition Reimbursement/Assistance Program
* Income Protection Plans
* Legal & Travel Assistance Plans
* EAP/Home Auto Insurance Plans
* Wireless/Auto/Computer Discount Plans

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Production & Operations**

* Provide full production support, with a strong emphasis on converting machine performance.
* Maximize productivity and minimize downtime through effective resource management.
* Coordinate with Maintenance on PMs, MVP, and machine uptime goals.
* Oversee converting production, including equipment installation and major repairs.
* Support cost-reduction strategies and drive productivity improvements.
* Ensure compliance with all company policies, safety protocols, and quality standards.

#### **Quality & Safety**

* Ensure plant focus on quality processes and tools for each converting machine.
* Maintain plant housekeeping standards and ensure machine cleaning programs are current.
* Drive safety initiatives and uphold OSHA, EPA, and company regulations.
* Oversee all audit protocols (third-party, customer, and internal).

#### **Leadership & Supervision**

* Directly supervise Converting employees and supervisors.
* Set and communicate quality, efficiency, and production standards.
* Provide training, coaching, conflict resolution, performance evaluations, and disciplinary action as needed.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, teamwork, and high morale.

#### **Administrative & Strategic Support**

* Evaluate new methods, machinery, and safety programs; contribute to planning, budgeting, and purchasing.
* Maintain optimal staffing levels daily.
* Communicate issues to the General Manager in a timely manner.
* Remain on-call and available after hours to address urgent production issues.
* Perform additional duties as assigned by management.

### **Qualifications**

#### **Required**

* High school diploma or GED
* 10 years of experience in corrugated manufacturing
* 5 years of proven management experience in a production environment

#### **Preferred**

* College degree
* Experience with Ward Servo Pro Die Cutters, Bobst 8.2, and Gopfert Die-Cutters
* 5+ years in converting manufacturing operations
* 2+ years in a supervisory role
* Proficiency in Lean/5S, OSHA, EPA regulations
* Mechanically inclined with strong troubleshooting skills
* Strong project management and coaching abilities

### **Skills & Competencies**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Sound mathematical and analytical capabilities
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and lead effective meetings
* Emotional resilience and conflict resolution skills
* Positive leadership presence and professional demeanor

### **Performance Measurements**

* **Operating Standards:** Meets/exceeds performance goals for production and customer service
* **Personal Growth:** Achieves annual professional development goals
* **Employee Relations:** Demonstrates effective team development, coaching, and motivation
* **Creativity:** Contributes innovative ideas to improve business operations

### **Physical & Work Environment Requirements**

* Regular walking, talking, hearing; frequent standing and reaching; occasional sitting
* Visual requirements include close, distance, color, peripheral vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
* Exposure to wet/humid conditions, mechanical parts, fumes/particles, and high noise levels

Requirements:

Pratt Industries is America's 5th largest paper and packaging company with more than 10,000 highly skilled employees dedicated to the environment and sustainability. Pratt Industries is one of the largest corrugated packaging companies in America, with sophisticated manufacturing facilities in more than a dozen states. The company operates three of the most modern, cost effective paper mills in the country, as well as a series of sheet and box plants strategically placed throughout the United States offering a wide range of creative packaging solutions. Pratt Industries is committed to recycling and the environment by “harvesting the urban forest." 
Pratt Industries offers competitive compensation plans with incentive opportunities, full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, FSA, All State, Pre-Paid Legal, and 401(k) with company match, paid vacation, and paid holidays.

new_roles.description:
**Job Description:**

**Plant Director**

 

**Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World**

Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

**This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role** 
As a **Plant Director**, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

 

* Leading a team of employees dedicated to making what is indispensable to empower modern life, advance human progress, and deliver a brighter future through 3M Science.
* Overseeing plant environment, health, safety, regulatory and security practices that respect our environment, meet requirements established by regulatory bodies, protect our employees, and align with company expectations.
* Leading operational excellence through conscientious management and decisive actions in environment, health, safety, quality, manufacturing, supply chain, cost, and employee relations.
* Utilizing operational financial acumen to analyze and understand the financial implications of various choices and actions, making informed decisions based on financial data to maximize profits and minimize losses.
* Understanding and applying technology platform fundamentals and principles, thinking strategically, and identifying opportunities to leverage technology for business growth and operational efficiency.
* Accelerating value creation for our customers through responsive end-to-end supply chain performance and prompt resolution to customer inquiries.
* Developing strategic plans and budgets to drive continuous and sustainable improvements through the application of disruptive technology, lean six sigma methods, and effective employee engagement programs.
* Managing inventory, and influencing supplier performance.
* Championing inclusive programs that create a great place to work for all our employees and demonstrating behavior aligned with a work environment in which employees, consultants, and contract workers know that ethical and legal behavior is always expected of them.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

 

* Bachelor’s degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start) from an accredited institution.
* Ten (10) years of experience in a manufacturing or production facility in private, public, government, or military environment.
* Five (5) years of experience in a plant leadership role.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

 

* Proven experience in plant leadership roles, demonstrating the ability to drive operational excellence and achieve results.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, quality control, and safety standards.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate teams.
* Demonstrated ability to anticipate future trends, effectively prepare for change, create and communicate change action plans, and implement sustainable change.
* Strategic mindset and the ability to develop and execute plans to meet operational goals.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in physical sciences, Operations Management, or a related field (advanced degree preferred).
* Experience in proven continuous improvement process improvement methodologies.

**Work location:**

* **Onsite, Tonawanda, New York**

**Travel: May include up to 10%** **domestic/international**

**Relocation Assistance: May be authorized**

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

**Chat with Max**

For assistance with searching through our current job openings or for more information about all things 3M, visit Max, our virtual recruiting assistant on 3M.com/careers.

Applicable to US Applicants Only:The expected compensation range for this position is $250,253 - $305,864, which includes base pay plus variable incentive pay, if eligible. This range represents a good faith estimate for this position. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant knowledge, training, skills, work location, and/or experience. In addition, this position may be eligible for a range of benefits (e.g., Medical, Dental & Vision, Health Savings Accounts, Health Care & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Disability Benefits, Life Insurance, Voluntary Benefits, Paid Absences and Retirement Benefits, etc.). Additional information is available at: https://www.3m.com/3M/en\_US/careers-us/working-at-3m/benefits/.Good Faith Posting Date Range 11/18/2026 To 12/18/2026 Or until filledAll US-based 3M full time employees will need to sign an employee agreement as a condition of employment with 3M. This agreement lays out key terms on using 3M Confidential Information and Trade Secrets. It also has provisions discussing conflicts of interest and how inventions are assigned. Employees that are Job Grade 7 or equivalent and above may also have obligations to not compete against 3M or solicit its employees or customers, both during their employment, and for a period after they leave 3M.Learn more about 3M’s creative solutions to the world’s problems at www.3M.com or on Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn @3M.Responsibilities of this position include that corporate policies, procedures and security standards are complied with while performing assigned duties.Safety is a core value at 3M. All employees are expected to contribute to a strong Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) culture by following safety policies, identifying hazards, and engaging in continuous improvement.Pay & Benefits Overview: https://www.3m.com/3M/en\_US/careers-us/working-at-3m/benefits/3M does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
As a leader and innovator in the snack food industry for over 50 years, J&J Snack Foods provides branded snack foods to foodservice and retail supermarket outlets across the U.S. Its products include such icons as SUPERPRETZEL, ICEE, and Dippin' Dots along with other key brands like LUIGI'S Real Italian Ice, The Funnel Cake Factory Funnel Cakes, and Hola Churros. J&J also has a strong presence in bakery providing cakes, cookies, and pies to some of the largest grocery and convenience retailers in industry. Our company continues to deliver record sales led by a talented team and a commitment to "Fun Served Here".

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Reporting to the Senior Director of Plant Operations, the Plant Manager serves as the senior leader responsible for the overall operational performance of a high-volume snack food manufacturing plant. This role oversees all day-to-day plant activities and is accountable for safety, quality, service, cost, people, and culture. The Plant Manager leads cross-functional teams across production, maintenance, quality, warehouse, planning, and sanitation to ensure the efficient production of high-quality products in alignment with company standards and financial targets. This position combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, translating company objectives into daily plant operations while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement. The Plant Manager plays a critical role in delivering the production plan, enhancing productivity and profitability, and fostering a safe, engaged, and high-performing workforce.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS****:**

* Leads and manages all aspects of plant operations, including production, maintenance, quality, warehouse, planning, and sanitation, to ensure the safe, efficient, and timely manufacturing of high-quality products.

* Establishes and sustains a strong safety culture by promoting a zero-injury mindset; ensure full compliance with all OSHA, FDA, GMP, HACCP, and environmental regulations through proactive programs, audits, and corrective actions.

* Delivers the production plan on time and in full by optimizing operational performance, including OEE, labor efficiency, yield, and waste reduction, while identifying and eliminating constraints and bottlenecks.

* Partners with Quality to uphold the highest food safety and product standards; ensure adherence to all quality systems, maintain audit readiness, and lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for quality deviations.

* Builds, leads, and develops a high-performing team by recruiting, training, and coaching supervisors and frontline employees; fosters a culture of accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement, while supporting succession planning and positive employee/labor relations.

* Owns and manages the plant's financial performance, including the operating budget, labor and overtime costs, waste, and conversion costs; monitor expenditures and drive cost-effective operations aligned with business objectives.

* Champions continuous improvement initiatives by implementing Lean manufacturing principles, 5S, and structured problem-solving methodologies; lead kaizen events and leverage data and KPIs to drive performance and decision-making.

* Ensures equipment reliability and optimal facility performance through strong partnership with maintenance; oversee preventive maintenance programs and manage capital improvement projects to support operational efficiency and long-term growth.

* Collaborates cross-functionally with Planning, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, and Distribution to align materials, staffing, and maintenance plans with production needs, including support for new product introductions and process changes.

* Tracks, analyzes, and reports key performance indicators related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people; communicate performance and improvement plans effectively to senior leadership.

* Performs other duties and special projects assigned to support plant operations and organizational objectives.

**COMPETENCIES:**

To perform this job successfully, the Plant Manager must be self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to solve problems while staying focused on priorities. The following knowledge, skills, and abilities are required:

* Excellent planning, organizational, and time-management skills, with the ability to balance production and maintenance priorities.

* Proven leadership and team-building abilities, including advanced coaching, employee development, and motivation skills.

* Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and active listening skills.

* Adaptable and flexible, able to navigate change and respond to evolving operational needs.

* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving capabilities.

* Collaborative, with the ability to lead team-based decision-making processes.

* Highly motivated, results-oriented, and driven to achieve operational excellence.

* Alignment with and passion for the company's mission, vision, values, and operating principles.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business Management, or a related field; Master's degree preferred. Equivalent experience will also be considered.

* Minimum of 7–10+ years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing, preferably in CPG or food production, with prior experience leading a plant or large production operation.

* Proven track record in safety management, including implementing and enforcing safety systems and ensuring compliance with OSHA and other regulatory standards.

* Extensive experience managing food quality systems and adhering to GMP and other industry requirements.

* Strong operational knowledge of manufacturing processes, maintenance, and engineering principles, with demonstrated practical application.

* Experience managing budgets, expenses, and cost performance, with solid financial and accounting understanding.

* Hands-on experience with continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, 5S, Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt preferred), or similar process improvement frameworks.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with enterprise systems such as SAP or JD Edwards is a plus.

Disclaimer: This position description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the team member. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

EEO Statement: J&J Snack Foods Corp.is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discriminatory employment actions against, and treatment of, employees and applicants for employment based on actual or perceived Federal, State and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination on the basis of race, color, age, national origin, ethnicity, alienage, religion or creed, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship, genetic disposition or characteristics, disability or veteran's status, sex offenses, prior record of arrest or conviction, genetic information or predisposing genetic characteristic, status as a victim or witness of domestic violence, sex offenses or stalking and unemployment status.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager - West Chicago
new_roles.description:
Company Statement: Graham Packaging is a people, planet and values-based company and a leader in sustainable packaging manufacturing. From the kitchen to the laundry room, Graham Packaging is part of your everyday life. For employees at Graham, our Blue Culture is part of their everyday lives, too. In other words, Blue is how we do things here. At Graham, we are united by a clear vision. We know our part and help those around us know theirs, encouraging one another to continuously improve. We create a safe, challenging environment to innovate by supporting creative ideas and new ways of thinking. We take the initiative to cultivate our individual growth and help others do the same, while keeping ourselves and one another accountable. And we actively promote cooperation, collaboration, integrity and respect across regions and teams to foster an engaged, diverse and connected workforce. We value our employees, and a Blue Culture allows for the most rewarding employee experience as part of the Graham family. Blue is how we feel about what we do—together—to create a better tomorrow. Working at Graham means you lead constructively with clear goals, use diverse thinking to drive excellence, accountability, innovation, as well as demonstrating collaboration, embracing learning, and taking action for continuous improvement and growth. Overview:

Plant Managers are responsible for overall effectiveness of day-to-day manufacturing operations through direction of personnel in the management of safety, quality, customer service, efficient utilization of resources, equipment, materials and manpower procedures and programs. The primary duties of a Plant Manager include:

* Understands, follows and enforces all established safety, health, quality GMP and Company policies, procedures and recognized practices.
* Understands, follows and enforces all established policies, procedures and recognized practices.
* Leads the plant safety initiatives through the participation and development of safety training programs, plant safety meetings, safety audits and by encouraging employee involvement through safety suggestion and recognition programs.
* Leads the plant quality initiatives through the implementation of corrective actions from customer or internal complaints, coordinating new product qualifications, and participating in internal and external quality system audits and developing and implementing corrective action plans.
* Responsible for the selection, training, growth and development of shift and staff personnel to attain organizational goals
* Reviews operating statements for all departments and directs manufacturing operations so that all plant costs are within budgetary standards.
* Develops and maintains sound relations with customers and works with them to identify systems improvements and possible supply chain cost reductions.
* Ensures continuous improvement plans are developed and implemented to ensure short and long range goals are in process.
* Oversees the production planning process to ensure customer requirements are satisfied.
* Maintains contact with sales department and customer service to effectively meet and maximize utilization of plant facilities.
* Act as the Plant’s Project Manager on new initiatives involving equipment and molds.
* Participates in monthly, quarterly and year-end physical inventories in accordance with corporate guidelines.
* Oversee the creation and implementation of plants strategic and tactical plans that provided the needed focus and drive to achieve the plant and overall company objectives.
* Drive continuous improvement plans using Operation Excellence tools across cross functional departments.
* Promote an open door and team building environment policy.
* May be responsible for special projects related to other functional areas

Qualifications:

A Bachelor’s Degree and/or related plant management experience; or equivalent combination of education and related plant management experience is required. A minimum of five years’ experience in an operations supervisory or management role in a manufacturing environment with demonstrated leadership skills strongly preferred. Six Sigma, Lean, and/or Kaizen experience preferred.

Plant Managers are required to interact with other managers, employees, vendors, and customers. Therefore, the following skills and proficiencies are also essential requirements of the position:

* Ability to maintain regular, predictable, and punctual attendance.
* Computer usage and typing skills are essential.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, including the ability to effectively communicate with internal and external customers.
* Must be able to work under pressure and meet deadlines, while maintaining a positive attitude and providing exemplary customer service.
* Ability to work independently and to carry out assignments to completion within parameters of instructions given, prescribed routines, and standard accepted practices.
* Communicates effectively: conveys facts and information clearly both verbally and orally.
* Collaborates well with others: proactively contributes to group objectives; volunteers to help others.

The final agreed-upon compensation is based on individual qualifications and experience. Benefits Statement: Benefits include medical, dental, vision and basic life insurance. Employees are able to enroll in the company’s 401K Employee Saving Plan and may participate in its Employee Wellness Program. Demonstrated knowledge of all facets of power plant operations. Demonstrated ability to make competent decisions in emergency situations, writing operating procedures and training of other personnel. new_roles.description:
**Job Title:**

Executive Vice President, Innovation & Quality

**Department:**

Leadership

**Reports To:**

CEO

**FLSA Status:**

Full-Time, Exempt

**Location:**

Brooksville, FL (on-site)

**Travel:**

Periodic travel (approx. 10–15%)

**Direct Reports:**

Director, R&D; Regulatory & Technical Services Manager; Quality Manager

**Date Modified:**

November 2026

**About Black Diamond Coatings (BDC Brands)**

Black Diamond Coatings, Inc. (BDC Brands) is a veteran- and family-owned manufacturer of premium, environmentally friendly home improvement products. Our DOMINATOR®, AQUA-X®, and OBSESS® brands are made in the USA and distributed through Amazon, Lowe’s, The Home Depot, Walmart, plus our own e-commerce site. Headquartered in Brooksville, Florida, we operate with an entrepreneurial spirit, high integrity, and a strong belief in teamwork, continuous improvement, and excellence.

**Mission:** Creating Trustworthy Solutions Beyond Expectations.

**Vision:** Our trusted brands deliver home improvement product solutions that “WOW” our DIY and Pro customers, setting the standard for quality and innovation.

**Position Summary**

The Executive Vice President, Innovation & Quality leads R&D, product innovation, quality, and regulatory compliance across the DOMINATOR®, AQUA-X®, and OBSESS® brands. Reporting to the CEO, this role owns BDC’s product development strategy and new-product pipeline, grows and protects our intellectual property, and owns our ISO 9001-certified quality system from formulation through shipment.

This is a builder’s role. The EVP sets technical direction, builds the team, and stays close enough to the bench to make fast, informed decisions. Innovation at BDC means shelf-ready products that win with our retail partners and customers, not open-ended research. Bold ideas are encouraged; products must be manufacturable, meet cost and quality targets, and ship on time.

**Champion BDC’s Core Values**

* Lead by example: demonstrate strong work ethic, integrity, and commitment to excellence in every interaction.
* Be resourceful and tenacious: do more with less, figure it out, and bring a relentless “will to win.”
* Stay positive as a team, communicate with honesty and respect, and hold yourself and others accountable to the BDC standard.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Innovation & Product Development**

* Set R&D strategy and own the product pipeline, aligned with company growth plans and retail partner priorities.
* Turn customer and market insight into products that outperform what is on the shelf, and expand the product line into new categories.
* Lead development of new, patentable technologies and protect BDC’s intellectual property.
* Run a disciplined, fast development process with clear go/no-go decisions.
* Improve the performance and cost of existing products, backed by solid test data.

**Quality**

* Own the quality system end to end and maintain ISO 9001 certification.
* Make quality a selling point with retail partners.

**Technical Support & Compliance**

* Oversee regulatory compliance and technical support so every product meets federal, state, and retailer requirements.

**Leadership & Partnership**

* Lead and develop the R&D, Quality, and Compliance teams through three direct reports.
* Partner with Operations to scale products from lab to full production.
* Work with Sales and Marketing on launches and retail buyer presentations.

**Job Qualifications**

**Required**

* Master’s or PhD in Chemistry, Polymer Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.
* 15+ years of product development in coatings, sealers, adhesives, cleaners, or specialty chemical consumer products, including 5+ years leading R&D teams.
* Proven record of taking products from concept to commercial launch, including developing patentable technology.
* Experience owning a QC/QA function under ISO 9001 or an equivalent quality management system.
* Deep expertise in water-based polymer and emulsion formulation; dry-blend experience is a plus.
* Hands-on lab skills and experience scaling products from lab to full production.
* Measured results using continuous improvement methods (Six Sigma, lean, or equivalent).
* Working knowledge of product regulatory requirements (SDS/GHS, VOC, EPA and state rules).
* Ability to travel approximately 10–15%.

**Preferred**

* Experience developing products for mass retail, including retailer testing and compliance.
* Category experience in home improvement, building products, or protective coatings.
* Experience building or scaling an R&D function in a growing, entrepreneurial company.
* Hands-on experience applying AI tools to R&D or quality work.

**Working Conditions**

On-site role based at BDC’s lab and manufacturing facility in Brooksville, FL. Regular laboratory work, including handling chemicals with appropriate PPE; outdoor field and application testing; and time on the production floor. Periodic travel to retail partners, suppliers, trade shows, and other BDC facilities.

Black Diamond Coatings, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations - Commercial Laundry
new_roles.description:
**LEAD OPERATIONS. DEVELOP PEOPLE. DRIVE RESULTS.**

Century Linen and Uniform is seeking an experienced, results-driven Director of Operations to lead and oversee operations across five commercial laundry and uniform rental facilities throughout New York State and Massachusetts.

This is a key leadership position responsible for driving operational excellence, improving financial performance, developing strong management teams, and ensuring consistency and accountability across all facilities.

The ideal candidate is a strategic and hands-on leader who understands how to manage a multi-location operation, develop General Managers, improve productivity, control costs, and build a culture of performance and accountability.

**WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

**Multi-Plant Leadership**

* Provide overall operational leadership and direction to five commercial laundry facilities.
* Lead, coach, and hold General Managers accountable for facility performance and results.
* Establish consistent operating standards, procedures, and expectations across all locations.
* Conduct regular facility visits to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and address operational challenges.

**Financial and Operational Performance**

* Oversee operational budgets, expenses, labor costs, overtime, and profitability.
* Partner with Finance to monitor financial results, identify variances, and implement corrective actions.
* Drive cost-control initiatives, productivity improvements, and operational efficiencies.
* Ensure each facility meets established financial and operational objectives.

**Production and Productivity**

* Oversee production performance, workflow, scheduling, labor utilization, and capacity planning.
* Monitor productivity, quality, rewash, linen loss, and production efficiency.
* Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to maximize throughput and resource utilization.
* Ensure production operations support customer demand and service commitments.

**Customer Service and Service Delivery**

* Ensure consistent service quality, accuracy, and on-time delivery.
* Partner with Sales, Customer Service, and Transportation to resolve operational issues.
* Establish accountability for customer complaints, service failures, shortages, and recurring quality concerns.

**Leadership and Employee Development**

* Recruit, develop, coach, and evaluate General Managers and key operational leaders.
* Establish clear performance expectations, measurable goals, and accountability standards.
* Address performance concerns and leadership gaps promptly.
* Build a culture of ownership, teamwork, communication, and continuous improvement.

**Maintenance, Engineering, and Safety**

* Partner with Engineering and Maintenance leadership to improve equipment reliability and reduce downtime.
* Support preventive maintenance programs, capital projects, and facility improvements.
* Promote a safe working environment and ensure compliance with applicable safety and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Human Resources and plant leadership on employee relations, workforce planning, and labor matters.

**Transportation and Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Transportation leadership to improve routing, fleet utilization, delivery performance, and operating efficiency.
* Work collaboratively with Finance, Human Resources, Sales, Engineering, Customer Service, and other departments.
* Provide regular operational updates, performance reports, and recommendations to executive leadership.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

The Director of Operations will be accountable for measurable improvements in:

* Plant profitability and performance against budget.
* Labor costs, overtime, and productivity.
* Pounds processed per labor hour and production efficiency.
* Customer service, on-time delivery, and quality.
* Rewash, shortages, and linen loss.
* Equipment reliability and downtime.
* Workplace safety and compliance.
* Staffing, employee retention, and General Manager performance.
* Execution of operational improvement initiatives.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Industrial Management, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 7–10 years of progressive operations management experience.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing multiple facilities, locations, or business units.
* Experience leading and developing General Managers, Plant Managers, or senior operational leaders.
* Commercial laundry, textile rental, manufacturing, distribution, or other labor-intensive industrial experience strongly preferred.
* Experience managing budgets, analyzing financial results, and improving operational profitability.
* Experience working in a unionized environment and interpreting collective bargaining agreements preferred.

**Leadership Qualities**

* Strong leadership and people-development skills.
* Ability to lead through others rather than micromanage.
* High level of accountability and the ability to hold others accountable.
* Strong financial and analytical abilities.
* Strategic thinking and sound business judgment.
* Effective communication and relationship-building skills.
* Decisive problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to implement change and drive continuous improvement.

**TRAVEL AND TRANSPORTATION REQUIREMENTS**

* This position requires frequent travel, potentially up to 90% of working time, among the company's five facilities throughout New York State and Massachusetts.
* Travel may include overnight stays, early morning departures, evening returns, weekends, and schedule adjustments based on operational needs.
* The employee is responsible for independently arranging reliable transportation to and from all assigned work locations and required reporting locations.
* The employee must be able to report to all assigned locations at the times and schedules required by the position.
* Company-provided bus transportation, if available, is offered as a convenience only and is not guaranteed. Bus service is subject to designated routes, schedules, and availability and may not accommodate the travel requirements or working hours of this position.
* Employees in this position may not rely on company-provided transportation as their sole means of commuting or traveling to required work locations.

This position requires regular presence in both office and industrial laundry environments, including production floors, maintenance areas, and loading docks. The employee must be comfortable working in environments with elevated temperatures, humidity, noise, moving equipment, industrial chemicals, and other conditions commonly found in commercial laundry facilities.

new_roles.title: Vice President, Final Control Operations
new_roles.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Vice President, Final Control Operations will provide overall leadership for Final Control Operations including valve field and shop testing and repair, production (new valve assembly) and valve inventory management. Responsibilities include developing and implementing strategies to enhance safety, quality, efficiency, and service levels through managing a team of Directors and Managers responsible for 100+ employees in 6 locations in the Southeast US. The role involves driving continuous improvement projects, ensuring compliance with safety and quality standards, and managing supply chain and inventory. Financial management, including budget development and cost control is essential to the success of this position. The role serves on the Control Southern Executive Leadership Team.

#### **Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Responsible for daily operations and implementing companywide operational strategies with a focus on financial growth, service levels and customer satisfaction.
* Active participation and collaboration on Company Leadership Team and Strategic Council.
* Interview, hire, train and mentor a team of Directors/Managers.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Develop and implement short-term and long-term strategies, structure, and process to achieve business results.
* Oversee planning, execution, and delivery for production/new valve assembly and services.
* Ensure quality control and compliance with industry standards.
* Provide weekly operational performance updates to the Executive Leadership Team.
* Maintain an exceptional and well communicated Safety Program.
* Oversight of warehouse operations including shipping & receiving, supply chain and inventory management.
* Develop, manage and achieve the annual operations budget and capital investment plan.
* Collaborate with other Operations Leaders from the Emerson Impact Partner Network.

#### **Other Duties:**

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

#### **Physical Demands:**

* Periodic visits to company operation centers and customer facilities or project sites, which require adherence to safety protocols and proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE). Typical facilities include Commercial Power Plants, Nuclear Plants, Pulp and Paper Mills, Chemical Plants, Manufacturing Plants, etc.
* Regular use of a computer, which may involve repetitive motion such as typing.
* Frequent use of the phone for communication with team members, stakeholders, and clients.

#### **Travel:**

* Overnight travel required to company operations centers currently in Chattanooga, TN; Decatur, AL; Jacksonville, FL; Lakeland, FL; Macon, GA, and Suwanee, GA
* Must be willing for overnight travels to work on site at customer
* Overnight travel may be required to attend factory and/or customer meetings as necessary.
* 50%+ travel depending on office location may be required.

#### **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or industrial engineering; MBA preferred.
* 10+ years of experience in operations management in manufacturing; experience in the valve or mechanical services industry preferred.
* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Knowledge of valve technology and assembly processes.
* Experience with lean manufacturing and project management.
* High Emotional Quotient for leading others.
* Experience leading Safety & Quality Programs.
* Strategic Inventory Optimization experience a plus.
* Strong financial acumen and analytical skills.

**About Control Southern**

Founded in 1956 and headquartered in Suwanee, Georgia, Control Southern is an integrated solutions provider that helps manufacturing plants across the Southeast run better, faster and smarter through automation and customized valve solutions. As an Emerson Impact Partner, we are the local point of contact for sales, service and applied engineering for Emerson's automation solutions in Georgia, Florida, East Tennessee and North Alabama. We are employee-owned through our ESOP, and our culture is grounded in our motto: ***When integrity leads, success follows.***

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Operations - Quality
new_roles.description:
**About the role:**
===================

This is a hands-on role with both strategic and executional scope. You will build and lead quality assurance and quality control standards across Operations, set the sampling, validation, and escalation practices the organization runs on, and partner closely with the Senior Manager, Operations - Payer Ops, the Human-in-the-Loop Operations leader, Product, and Engineering. You will report to the Head of Operations and help define the company's AI/Human QA strategy as Adonis scales.

**What you'll do:**
===================

**Own the Quality Program across Operations**
---------------------------------------------

* Define and own QA/QC standards, sampling methodologies, audit practices, and validation processes across AI agent outputs, human-executed work, and vendor-delivered operations.
* Develop & present quarterly plans and operating metrics; communicate progress and trade-offs; surface risks early + Work closely with the Head of Operations on strategic projects
* Lead quality assurance for payer workflows and agent outcomes, including new payer activations on the voice channel.
* Lead the development and implementation of a near-real-time QA Dashboard to provide visibility into quality, identify performance gaps, and track improvement over time.
* Partner with the operations team and external vendors to ensure work consistently meets Adonis's accuracy, operational, and compliance standards.
* Partner closely with the operations team to align on quality standards, remediation priorities, and operational performance.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to address quality gaps, improve workflows, and support strategic initiatives.
* Serve as the quality subject matter expert across Operations, ensuring quality considerations are incorporated into new workflows, product launches, and operational changes.

**Turn quality findings into operational and product improvements**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

* Translate and present quality trends and findings into actionable recommendations for Product, Engineering, and Operations, driving improvements from identification through implementation and validation.
* Leverage AI, automation, and internal tooling to increase the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of QA/QC processes.
* Establish quality thresholds and escalation criteria for uncertain, complex, or high-impact outcomes.

**Build and lead a high-performing quality function**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Build and scale the Quality function, establishing clear goals, ownership, processes, and performance metrics.
* Lead, coach, and develop onshore and offshore team members, as the function grows.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, playbooks, training materials, and quality guidelines to support operational consistency and continuous improvement.

**Who you are:**
================

* 6+ years of experience
* Experience in healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) is required, with practical understanding of payer, claims, or related revenue-cycle workflows.
* Experience building or leading quality assurance, quality control, or quality programs in a technology-enabled operations environment.
* Experience coaching a team and creating clarity across multiple workstreams.
* Experience defining operating standards, evaluating results, investigating failures, and ensuring corrective actions are effective.
* Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, customer-facing teams, and operational partners.
* Comfort moving between strategic planning and hands-on operational detail in a fast-changing environment.
* An AI-forward mindset and practical experience applying AI, automation, or intelligent tooling to improve quality and operational performance, with sound judgment about when human review is needed.

The base salary range for this position is $140,000 to $180,000. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to base salary, we also offer competitive equity and benefits packages.

**About Adonis**
================

Adonis is the leading AI orchestration platform for healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), purpose-built for healthcare organizations seeking to transform their revenue operations. Traditional RCM processes often struggle with inefficiencies, costing providers up to 15% or more of their potential revenue. Through advanced automation, data science, and AI Agents, Adonis helps revenue teams detect vulnerabilities, optimize workflows, and deploy precise solutions that drive reliable and scalable financial outcomes.

Adonis is headquartered in New York City and has raised over $95M in funding, including a recent $40M Series C round led by Quadrille Capital with continued support from existing investors such as General Catalyst and Bling Capital. This funding supports our mission to restore sanity to RCM and equip provider groups and health systems with AI-driven revenue cycle operations at scale.

**Compensation Philosophy**
===========================

Actual base pay will depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Adonis determines compensation based on each candidate’s experience and qualifications relative to peers, and most new hires fall near the middle of the range. In addition to base salary, you’ll receive meaningful equity and great benefits.

**Perks at Adonis**
===================

* Competitive equity packages
* Employer-paid medical insurance
* Employer-paid dental insurance
* Employer-paid vision insurance
* Employer-funded HSA
* Parental leave
* Commuter benefits
* Office lunches every day
* Office snacks
* Generous PTO
* Located in 3 World Trade Center with easy access to all trains and the PATH, and amazing views of the city

Adonis is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

At Adonis, we fully comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals.

new_roles.title: Manager/Senior Manager, Manufacturing Investigations
new_roles.description:
**Job summary**
---------------

The Manager, Manufacturing Investigations, position is strategically intended to support continuous process improvement by developing and leading a team of investigators in analyzing cross-functional non-conformance events (“Deviations”), defining root cause, assessing product impact, and implementing Corrective/ Preventive actions. The Manager should possess proven technical writing and problem-solving skills as well as a desire for developing investigators in the art of problem-solving analysis. This is a direct supervisor position also responsible for the training and development of the investigators as well as for their overall performance. An understanding of Biotechnology Upstream, Downstream, and Support principles with experience in non-conformance management is ideal.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* The Manager is responsible for oversight of the Manufacturing Operations’ deviation performance. The incumbent is responsible for the assignment of the deviations, ensuring departmental deviation ownership is balanced and appropriately distributed to facilitate timely and quality closure.
* Train and mentor a team of investigators to conduct comprehensive investigations to determine root cause, product impact and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Methodically investigate and troubleshoot Manufacturing deviations using defined troubleshooting and investigational techniques. Develop and implement preventive actions to reduce the potential of recurrence or proactively prevent the occurrence of a new deviation.
* Ensure non-conformance investigations meet or exceed the rigor of internal, client and regulatory reviewers.

**Minimum Requirements**
------------------------

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

* BA/BS Degree in a science field preferred (i.e., Biology, Microbiology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, etc.) or equivalent combination of education and experience; 10+ years of pharmaceutical or related work experience with emphasis on current Good Manufacturing Practices including QA, QC, Validation, Manufacturing, or Process Engineering.

Salary Range: $118,000 - $148,000

Salary range provided per current averages and expectations. The salary and job title for this opening will be based on the selected candidate’s qualifications and experience and may be outside this range. KBI has a robust total rewards strategy which includes an annual bonus structure for all employees, medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid PTO and holidays, 401K matching with 100% vesting in 60 days and employee recognition programs.

 

*KBI Biopharma, Inc. is an EEO/AA employer and actively seeks to diversify its work force. Therefore, all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, national origin, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability or veteran status, are strongly encouraged to apply.*

*I understand that neither the completion of this application nor any other part of my consideration for employment establishes any obligation for KBI Biopharma, Inc. to hire me. If I am hired, I understand that either KBI Biopharma, Inc. or I can terminate my employment at any time and for any reason, with or without cause and without prior notice. I understand that no representative of KBI Biopharma, Inc. has the authority to make any assurance to the contrary.*

*I attest with my signature below that I have given to KBI Biopharma, Inc. true and complete information on this application. No requested information has been concealed. I authorize KBI Biopharma, Inc. to contact references provided for employment reference checks. If any information I have provided is untrue, or if I have concealed material information, I understand that this will constitute cause for the denial of employment or immediate dismissal.*

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager, Operations
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**

The Senior Operations Manager leads the machining department (approximately 60 employees) through supervisors and technical specialists. The role is accountable for safety, quality, on-time delivery, capacity utilization, productivity, and margins in a high-mix, low-volume precision CNC environment.

This is a people-and-business leadership position focused on removing barriers, driving continuous improvement, and partnering with the General Manager and Business Development to support profitable growth. Hands-on machining or CNC programming is not required.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Safety & Quality: Maintain a safety-first culture. Partner with Quality to uphold ISO standards, reduce nonconformances, and lower cost of poor quality through root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Operational Performance & Capacity: Direct production through supervisors across milling, turning, and secondary operations. Improve throughput by reducing bottlenecks, setup times, downtime, and waste. Optimize capacity planning, staffing, sequencing, and preventive maintenance.
* Delivery & Customer Execution: Own on-time delivery from order release through shipment. Ensure realistic schedules, visible priorities, and proactive recovery plans. Coordinate cross-functionally with Planning, Quality, Purchasing, and Shipping.
* Financial & Margin Management: Partner with Finance and the General Manager to protect and improve gross margin through labor productivity, material yield, scrap reduction, and disciplined cost control. Monitor job costs and provide reliable data for quoting, make/buy decisions, and capital recommendations.
* Systems & Continuous Improvement: Drive adoption, accuracy, and continuous improvement of ERP/MRP and shop-floor systems. Apply Lean tools (5S/6S, standard work, SMED, value-stream mapping, Kaizen) where they deliver measurable results. Develop practical performance dashboards and management reviews.
* People Leadership & Culture: Develop supervisors, team leads, and production personnel through coaching, clear expectations, and empowerment. Build engagement, retention, skills development, and succession. Foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Growth Partnership: Support Business Development with capacity assessments, customer meetings, and opportunity qualification to profitably fill available machine capacity.

**Key Performance Measures**

* Safety performance
* On-time delivery and schedule adherence
* Throughput, labor productivity, setup time, and unplanned downtime
* Capacity utilization and available capacity for new work
* Gross margin, job-cost variance, and scrap/rework costs
* ERP/MRP data accuracy and timely reporting
* Employee engagement, retention, and internal development
* Nonconformance trends and cost of quality

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience leading manufacturing teams or operations departments, preferably in CNC machining, high-mix/low-volume contract manufacturing, or precision manufacturing. Hands-on machinist or programming experience is not required.
* Demonstrated improvements in productivity, on-time delivery, profitability, and operational performance, supported by measurable results.
* Experience implementing or improving ERP/MRP systems, production scheduling, job costing, and KPI reporting.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, business acumen, change management, and cross-functional communication skills.
* Practical understanding of capacity, cost drivers, scheduling, Lean methods, and ISO-based quality systems.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or business preferred; equivalent relevant leadership experience will be considered.

**Role Alignment**

This role manages the machining department through its supervisors and technical staff, with accountability for people development, operational performance, and continuous improvement. The Senior Operations Manager partners with the General Manager on business priorities, financial objectives, and capital recommendations, and with Business Development on customer relationships and growth.

The position does not require personally operating or programming CNC equipment. Final authority for pricing, hiring, capital spending, and related decisions will be defined by company leadership.

**Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled**

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Quality, Fauna
new_roles.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life. We are hiring a Senior Manager to lead the quality, test engineering, and reliability organization supporting our robots from development through production. 
In this role, you will improve product and manufacturing quality while building the testing capabilities needed to scale. Your organization will support new product introduction through volume production across our facilities, suppliers, and manufacturing partners. 
You will build the team and its engineering leadership, set the technical direction, and establish quality standards and validation processes. You will turn changing product and manufacturing needs into a roadmap that supports higher production volumes and additional sites. 
The ideal candidate is a technically strong engineering leader who has improved quality and reliability for products where hardware and software must work together. They can evaluate test strategies and guide critical supplier, production, and reliability investigations. They grow engineers and leaders, and make clear decisions on scope and priority while product designs and manufacturing processes are changing. 
 
Key job responsibilities 

* Architect the quality, test engineering, and reliability organization. Assess capability gaps, define the staffing and investment plan, and hire and develop the engineering leaders and teams needed to scale.
* Establish supplier and factory quality teams, with Fauna engineers embedded at manufacturing sites. Strengthen and scale the quality system to support new products and increasing production volumes.
* Define and lead the reliability strategy, working with our engineers to improve robot performance and durability.
* Build and scale reliability labs and test infrastructure to support product development and production growth.
* Scale and develop the manufacturing test engineering team, shaping its structure, growing its leaders, and strengthening its capabilities to support new products and increasing production volumes.
* Deploy and qualify production test systems across our facilities and manufacturing partners. Partner with the software and systems team on automation and traceable results, and improve repeatability, cycle time, and failure diagnosis.
* Partner with engineering and operations to embed quality, reliability, and testability into product design and production readiness.
* Establish quality and reliability metrics and use production, test, and field data to guide priorities and drive sustained improvement.

 
About the team 
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
 
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
 
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
 
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
 
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a related field
* 10+ years in quality, test engineering, or reliability for complex electromechanical products.
* 5+ years managing multidisciplinary engineering teams, with a track record of building organizations and developing engineers and leaders.
* Experience scaling supplier and manufacturing quality through NPI and production ramp, with strong knowledge of quality systems.
* Technical depth in reliability and manufacturing test engineering, with experience scaling test programs and infrastructure for integrated hardware-software products.
* Strong command of statistical analysis and structured problem-solving, with demonstrated success turning engineering data into product and process improvements.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with robotics or autonomous systems.
* Experience leading engineering managers or distributed teams across multiple manufacturing sites.
* Experience working with contract manufacturers and suppliers globally
* Experience with product safety certification or formal quality management standards.

 
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. 
 
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality
new_roles.description:
At GE Appliances, a Haier company, we come together to make “good things, for life.” As the fastest-growing appliance company in the U.S., we’re powered by creators, thinkers and makers who believe that anything is possible and that there’s always a better way. We believe in the power of our people and in giving them the freedom to explore, discover and build good things, together.

 

The GE Appliances philosophy, backed by three simple commitments defines the way we work, invent, create, do business, and serve our communities: *we come together*, *we always look for a better way*, and *we create possibilities*.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must be able to maintain such authorization without current or future employer or school sponsorship. GE Appliances will not sponsor employment-based visas for this position now or in the future.

Interested in joining us on our journey?

 
The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality leads a team supporting the execution of short-term and long term projects focused on product and process quality improvement. The role supports front-line leadership and development of both salary and hourly team members in support of the factory Manufacturing Control Plans. The role is responsible for working cross-functionally to execute the overall goal for reducing the cost of poor quality associated with plant operations and product performance post-sale.

**Position**
------------

Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality

**Location**
------------

USA, Louisville, KY

**How You'll Create Possibilities**
-----------------------------------

* Live, promote and support the Appliance Production System (APS) philosophy and drive continuous improvement in the quality and adjacent areas. Coach all team members to ensure cross-functional, focused collaboration is the way we work.
* Partner with the Quality Improvement Engineering, Business Operations and Manufacturing Engineering Leaders to promote a culture that establishes, sustains and improves product quality through engineering problem solving and discipline around supporting systems. Promote a method-based quick response to new issues.
* Responsible for developing and tracking team performance metrics tied to the overall factory (FPY, EOLA, Scrap) and effect to the product line financial plan (Damage, Scrap). Leads the team to complete projects and tasks supporting this effort. Owns and assigns tasks and establishes accountability at the appropriate level.
* Closely collaborates with the product line Engineering, Field Quality and Service organizations to understand and respond to part or system product level performance issues impacting owner use and satisfaction. Responds to this data in addition to internal data streams (leading indicators) for product quality and reliability (Engineering, EOLA and audit labs).
* Identify and execute projects to improve the cost of operations. Serve as a broad owner for Corrective and Preventative Actions (CAPA), Corrective Action Request (CAR) approach to problem solving.
* Owner of the execution of attributes of the Manufacturing Control Plan for broad areas. Responsible for the training, execution, auditing and improvement of the Manufacturing Quality Control Plan. Support efforts intended to improve workstation documentation process; create, update and maintain Manufacturing Control Instructions (MCI’s), visual aid and alerts (single point lessons) as needed.
* Strong technical aptitude and ability to coach others in complex engineering topics like dimensional control, material properties, failure analysis as well as emerging technologies such as AI
* Support analysis of data as part of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and implementation of responses as required by MCI/MCP. Escalate and measure response to data trends. Validate root cause response for effectiveness.
* Lead and support 1x1 problem solving for quality systems and related issues collaborate cross functionally to improve product quality through the identification and elimination of root cause of issues. Focus on overall repair efficiency.

**What You'll Bring to Our Team**
---------------------------------

* 8+ Years of successful experience in Manufacturing / Quality, focused on providing operational support to support operations and vertical manufacturing operations.
* Demonstrated expertise in a combination of Metrology, CMM or 3D scanning of complicated assemblies
* Ability to work within large cross-functional teams and at multiple levels in the organization.
* Demonstrated excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrated experience as a hands-on problem solver including complex systems (supply, build, testing and diagnosis)
* Demonstrated leadership during technically challenging and complicated cross functional projects/tasks

**Desired Characteristics**

* Engineering degree with strong content tied to understanding and impact to business financial performance
* Quality Leadership experience
* Prior experience in a union environment
* Strong organizational skills- focused on project and resource management

### **Working Conditions**

### 

* Working conditions are normal for a high-volume manufacturing environment.
* Working in this environment will occasionally require the use of safety equipment to include but not limited to: eye safety glasses, hearing protectors, work boots, and hardhats.
* These roles require frequent walking in a manufacturing plant environment.
* Travel (up to 10%) to suppliers and other manufacturing locations as needed.
* This position will be located in Louisville, KY.
* Hours & Weekends: Working off-shift and weekends may be required.

**Our Culture**
---------------

Our work is centered on our People and Culture as reflected in our Zero Distance philosophy and we recognize the importance of reaffirming our commitment to inclusion and diversity (I&D). This underscores our commitment to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, connected, and empowered to contribute, while positioning our organization to adapt seamlessly to the evolving needs of our workforce and communities. 
 
This reflects our dedication to creating solutions that: Empower colleagues by fostering an environment where all voices are heard, valued, and encouraged to contribute. Strengthen communities where we live and work. Reinforce a culture of belonging, purpose, and engagement. Reflect the diversity of the communities we serve through our workforce, products, and practices. 
 
By further embedding Zero Distance into our People and Culture framework, we will continue to build a deeply connected organization. We are cultivating a culture of engagement, belonging, and connection, because while attracting new talent remains a priority, retention is a cornerstone of our strategy.

GE Appliances is a trust-based organization. It is important we offer our employees the flexibility they need to do their best work while balancing the needs of the business and individuals. When you join GE Appliances, you will have the opportunity to work with your leader to create a flexible work arrangement that balances the needs of the individual, team, and organization.

GE Appliances is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Appliances participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S

*If you are an individual with a disability and need assistance or an accommodation to use our website or to apply, please send an e-mail* *to ask.recruiting@geappliances.com*

new_roles.title: Senior Manager - Operations External Manufact
new_roles.description:
**Senior Manager, Operations External Manufacturing**

**About the Company:**

At Horizon Organic, we’re growing a culture of passionate people driven to do good for the horizon we all share. We’re building the tomorrow we want to see. Every single day.

Joining our team means being part of a dynamic environment where your skills are valued, and your contributions make a real difference. We offer diverse opportunities for career growth and development. Embark on a rewarding journey with us in shaping the future of organic dairy!

Two generations of families—and counting—have grown up on Horizon Organic® milk. From the start, as the leading organic milk producer in the U.S., Horizon has been committed to delivering innovative, nourishing dairy that growing families can rely on. In 2023, Horizon Organic became a brand of Platinum Equity. Today, Horizon works with more than 500 farmers across the U.S. to bring high-quality, certified organic milk to consumers. For more information on Horizon’s full portfolio of organic dairy products, visit Horizon.com.

**About the Job:**

We are currently looking to hire a **Senior Manager, Operations External Manufacturing** to join our Supply Chain Department.

Leads external manufacturing operations and network optimization activities across contract manufacturing partners. This role is responsible for ensuring external manufacturing partners deliver excellence in Safety, Quality, Cost, and Delivery while supporting business growth, supply continuity, and operational effectiveness. The position partners closely with Procurement, PMO, Quality, R&D, Finance, Brand, Planning, Logistics, Customer Experience, and Milk Procurement teams to drive execution and continuous improvement across the external manufacturing network.

The Senior Manager - Operations External Manufacturing is responsible for the operational leadership of external manufacturing partners, management of manufacturing qualifications, execution of network optimization initiatives, and oversight of manufacturing performance across assigned facilities. This role develops and implements operational strategies, establishes performance expectations, leads cross functional initiatives, and ensures external manufacturing partners deliver products safely, efficiently, and in alignment with business objectives.

*This is a hybrid position with an expectation of 3 days per week on-site in Broomfield, CO.*

**This role may be responsible for, but not limited to:**

* Lead operational management of external manufacturing partners across assigned manufacturing networks.
* Oversee manufacturing qualification activities and support successful onboarding of new external manufacturing partners.
* Manage execution of network optimization initiatives, including transitions between manufacturing partners and facility rationalization activities.
* Establish and communicate operational performance expectations across Safety, Quality, Cost, and Delivery metrics.
* Monitor manufacturing partner performance and ensure corrective actions are identified, implemented, and sustained.
* Champion cross-functional project teams supporting network optimization, manufacturing transitions, and strategic initiatives.
* Partner with Procurement, PMO, Quality, R&D, Finance, Brand, Planning, Logistics, Customer Experience, and Milk Procurement teams to ensure successful project execution.
* Develop and execute strategies that improve manufacturing performance, service levels, and operational efficiency.
* Evaluate manufacturing capabilities and identify opportunities to optimize network performance.
* Ensure manufacturing partners operate in compliance with company standards, quality requirements, and operational expectations.
* Support supply continuity planning and mitigation activities associated with manufacturing risks and constraints.
* Analyze operational performance trends and develop recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with external manufacturing partners.
* Lead initiatives that improve collaboration, communication, and execution across the external manufacturing network.
* Prepare and present operational performance updates, risks, and recommendations to leadership teams

*The base compensation range for this position is $125,000 - $140,000 commensurate with experience*.

**About You:**

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Engineering, Manufacturing, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 7 years of experience in manufacturing, operations, supply chain, or related disciplines.
* Experience working within Consumer Packaged Goods, food, beverage, dairy, or manufacturing environments.
* Experience leading operational improvement initiatives and cross-functional projects.
* Experience managing suppliers, co-manufacturer, or contract manufacturing relationships.
* Experience developing and implementing operational strategies.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing, supply chain, and consumer packaged goods operations.
* Experience managing external manufacturing partners, suppliers, or co-manufacturers.
* Strong strategic planning and network optimization capabilities.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to evaluate complex operational challenges and implement effective solutions.
* Strong project management and cross-functional leadership capabilities.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Proven ability to develop and implement operational strategies and performance improvements.
* Strong leadership and organizational effectiveness skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience managing external manufacturing networks.
* Experience supporting network optimization and manufacturing transition initiatives.
* Experience leading large cross-functional business projects.
* Experience working with contract manufacturing and co-manufacturing environments.
* Experience supporting supply chain, logistics, planning, and procurement functions.
* Strong understanding of operational performance metrics and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Project management certification or formal project management training preferred.
* Ability to travel up to 25% or more as required.
