new_roles.title: Senior Manager Quality
new_roles.description:
**We believe that great healthcare is an essential safeguard of human dignity.**

At Laborie, we know the work we do matters – it’s what fuels our motivation and contributes to our success. If you’re ready to make a positive impact in the lives of patients across the globe, we’d like to meet you.

We support and empower our employees to grow their careers in an environment that encourages a sense of belonging and a connection to doing good. We’re not afraid to roll up our sleeves to make our goals a reality and work together to solve for our customers. We reward and recognize our employees based on our values of **Aspire to Greatness, Respect All, Own It, Working Together, Persist with Passion.**

**Who We’re Looking For:**

To ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and the Laborie Medical Quality Systems in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of Laborie Medical products. The position supports corporate wide process improvement initiatives relating to Quality and Regulatory.

**About the Role:**

* Develop and direct quality strategies, objectives, policies and procedures for assigned sites and Quality Management Systems.
* Directly responsible for the CAPA, Internal Audit, Complaint Handling and Training Systems for assigned sites and Quality Management Systems, including results against Quality Objectives related to these areas.
* Provide team leadership, development, and talent management activities including coaching, resource forecasting, hiring, performance management, training, and budgeting for the Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering functions to meet the company's objectives.
* Maintain quality standards set forth in the Laborie Medical Quality Manual(s) and those of its subsidiaries.
* Influence management and staff to encourage continuous improvement of quality and compliance.
* Proactively identify/resolve compliance risks.
* Fulfill the duties of back-up Management Representative.
* Play prominent role in acquisition due diligence and integration efforts.
* Prioritize and manage continuous improvement activities for Laborie
* Provide technical recommendations based on trend analysis to eliminate future problems and execute changes as necessary.
* Maintain compliance to all applicable regulations for the marketing of medical devices.
* Manage the CAPA process for all the company QMS’s.
* Lead auditee and serves as escort during inspections and audits performed by external regulatory bodies and internal auditors.
* Execute miscellaneous tasks, as assigned.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* BS or BA in Business Administration/Computer Sciences/Engineering or related degree
* Experience in a leadership position with direct supervision of Quality/Regulatory professionals
* Minimum 8 years’ experience working in a medically regulated industry in a Quality or Regulatory position.
* Experience with ISO13485, MDSAP, MDR, CFR820
* Experience with Project Management, Problem Solving, Six Sigma, Lean Management Systems, Root Cause Analysis, and other standard Quality tools
* Strong project management skills and attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills, cross department collaboration and leadership skills

**Why Laborie:**

Our Mission every day is to operate as a world-class specialist medical company making and advancing technologies that preserve and restore human dignity. We do that today by helping people with pelvic and gastrointestinal conditions live normal lives, and by helping mothers and babies have safe deliveries.

* Paid time off and paid volunteer time
* Medical, Dental, Vision and Flexible Spending Account
* Health Savings Account with Company Funded Contributions
* 401k Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Parental Leave and Adoption Services
* Health and Wellness Programs and Events

We are interested in a qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we will not be sponsoring work visas for this position, at this time.

*Laborie* *provides equal employment opportunities and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person’s race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Laborie is committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in our services, activities, education, and employment for individuals with disabilities.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager - Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
Lead continuous improvement at our Battle Creek, Michigan manufacturing facility, where your work will shape performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost and growth. As a key member of the plant leadership team, you will set the CI vision, advise site leaders on strategy and lead a team of continuous improvement professionals.

You will own the plant's management operating system and annual cost-out process while building the capabilities that sustain results. This role combines enterprise-level thinking with daily visibility on the plant floor, giving you the opportunity to turn data, Lean methods and cross-functional partnership into measurable operational gains.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set and execute the plant's continuous improvement strategy, creating the behaviors, systems and culture needed to achieve plant goals.
* Lead, coach and develop the salaried continuous improvement team while building Lean problem-solving capability across functions.
* Own the plant management operating system, annual cost-out process and A3 strategy documents, including daily, weekly and monthly performance tracking.
* Identify, scope and prioritize breakthrough and incremental improvement opportunities using plant data and operational metrics.
* Teach and model root-cause analysis, DMAIC, standard work, waste reduction, recurrence prevention and structured follow-up.
* Facilitate Kaizen events and cross-functional improvement efforts that strengthen safety, quality, delivery, cost, yield and equipment effectiveness.
* Maintain the plant continuous improvement project docket, track savings and communicate project status and results to operations leadership.
* Partner with operations, engineering and technical teams to implement sustainable solutions and share best practices across PCB facilities.
* Serve as a change leader who constructively challenges non-value-added work and helps teams navigate resistance to change.

**Why You'll Love This Role**

* A visible seat on the plant leadership team with direct influence on site strategy and operational performance.
* The opportunity to build CI capability across the organization and leave a clear handprint on how the plant works.
* Broad collaboration with operations, engineering and CI leaders across Post Consumer Brands.
* A role where big company resources meet a practical, hands-on plant environment.

**Location & Travel Requirements**

* This role is based at the Battle Creek, Michigan manufacturing facility.

**Education**

* A bachelor's degree in science, engineering, management or a related field is preferred.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5 or more years of related experience in a manufacturing environment.
* 3 or more years of successful leadership experience guiding teams that execute continuous improvement or Lean Six Sigma work.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable efficiency, effectiveness and financial benefits through continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience operating in a large manufacturing plant environment.
* Deep working knowledge of Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement methods, including root-cause analysis, DMAIC, Kaizen and waste reduction.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects, use operational data to set priorities and sustain improvements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in food manufacturing.
* Experience working in a union manufacturing environment.
* Experience in food or automotive manufacturing settings.
* Experience leading Black Belt-level or transformational cost-out initiatives.

**Success in This Role**

* Builds trust and strong working relationships across plant leadership, operations, engineering and frontline teams.
* Influences, coaches and develops others while setting clear expectations and maintaining accountability for results.
* Communicates a compelling improvement vision and translates complex problems into organized, practical action plans.
* Uses sound analytical and business judgment to solve complex problems and prioritize actions quickly.
* Leads change with candor, optimism and respect, including in environments where established ways of working may be challenged.
* Demonstrates a consistent commitment to a safe, respectful workplace.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**

If you are ready to lead transformational improvement, develop strong teams and help a large manufacturing operation perform at its best, bring your experience and big ambitions to Post Consumer Brands.

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager, Manufacturing Engineering
new_roles.description:
**Hyve Company Overview**
-------------------------

Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.

 
 

Hyve Solutions is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Manufacturing Engineering Manager to lead engineering operations within our fast-paced, high-volume PCBA manufacturing environment. This position is responsible for driving manufacturing process development, equipment performance, automation, and continuous improvement while ensuring the successful transition of new products from introduction (NPI) into stable, scalable mass production. The ideal candidate combines strong SMT/PCBA technical expertise with proven leadership capabilities, a passion for solving complex manufacturing challenges, and a proactive, floor-oriented approach to engineering. We are looking for a leader who takes ownership of manufacturing performance, develops strong engineering teams, and drives practical, sustainable solutions that improve quality, throughput, efficiency, and operational scalability.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead, develop, and manage the Manufacturing Engineering team, establishing clear priorities, technical accountability, and performance expectations
* Own manufacturing process development, optimization, and technical support across SMT, automated assembly, soldering, inspection, and related PCBA manufacturing operations
* Lead the transition of new products from NPI into high-volume production, ensuring manufacturing readiness, process capability, equipment qualification, and sustainable production performance
* Partner with NPI, Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Quality, and Operations to identify manufacturability risks, resolve technical challenges, and establish robust production processes
* Drive equipment programming, process parameter optimization, machine capability improvements, and automation initiatives to maximize manufacturing efficiency and reliability
* Provide hands-on technical leadership in troubleshooting complex equipment failures, process defects, yield losses, and recurring production issues
* Establish and improve manufacturing process controls, validation methods, and standardized engineering practices to ensure consistent product quality and repeatability
* Lead root cause investigations and corrective actions for manufacturing-related defects, equipment issues, and process instability
* Evaluate and implement new manufacturing technologies, equipment, tooling, and automation solutions to improve production capability and support business growth
* Support manufacturing capacity expansion, equipment installation, production line integration, and facility transitions while minimizing operational disruptions
* Analyze manufacturing performance metrics, including yield, cycle time, throughput, downtime, and process capability, to identify improvement opportunities and drive measurable results
* Collaborate with Operations, Quality, Maintenance, and Materials teams to establish manufacturing priorities, resolve production constraints, and improve overall operational performance
* Develop and maintain manufacturing engineering standards, process documentation, work instructions, and change control processes to support consistent execution
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on defect reduction, equipment utilization, labor efficiency, cost reduction, and manufacturing scalability
* Develop engineering talent through technical mentorship, structured problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement of team capabilities

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent experience may be considered
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive manufacturing engineering experience, including 3 years in an engineering leadership or management role, preferred
* Preferred hands-on experience in SMT and PCBA manufacturing processes, including pick and place equipment, solder paste printing, reflow soldering, AOI, AXI, selective soldering, and related manufacturing processes
* Demonstrated success transitioning products from NPI through production qualification, ramp-up, and sustained high-volume manufacturing
* Experience with industrial automation, equipment integration, machine programming, and manufacturing process controls
* Proven ability to lead technical teams, establish accountability, develop engineering talent, and manage competing priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment
* Strong understanding of manufacturing process validation, root cause analysis, defect reduction, yield improvement, and equipment reliability
* Familiarity with IPC standards, DFM/DFT principles, PFMEA, SPC, and structured problem-solving methodologies
* Familiarity with ISO9001 and ISO14001

**What’s in it for you**
------------------------

Benefit Insurance

* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Mental Health Care
* 401K with match
* Paid Holidays, Vacation & Sick Days
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Perks at Work
* LEAP Program
* MyFlexPay

***We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.***

new_roles.title: Senior Manager of Production
new_roles.description:
Gwynedd Manufacturing is seeking a hands-on Senior Manager of Production with a strong CNC machining background to lead day-to-day operations in a high-precision environment. This role is ideal for someone who has progressed through the ranks—from the shop floor into leadership—and is ready to step into a broader operational role.

The ideal candidate brings deep, practical knowledge of CNC machining (mills, lathes, EDM) and thrives in a fast-paced, high-tolerance manufacturing setting. This is not a purely strategic role—this leader will be actively engaged on the floor, driving performance, mentoring teams, and continuously improving processes.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead daily plant operations with a strong presence on the manufacturing floor, ensuring output, quality, and efficiency targets are met
* Direct oversight of machining operations including CNC mills, lathes, and EDM, ensuring optimal machine utilization and performance
* Manage and develop a team of supervisors, leads, and machinists (50–100+ employees)
* Serve as a technical resource and mentor, supporting setup, programming, and troubleshooting when needed
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on cycle time reduction, scrap reduction, and process standardization
* Partner closely with Engineering and Quality to ensure tight tolerance requirements and manufacturability of parts
* Own production scheduling, workflow optimization, and labor planning to meet customer demand
* Establish and reinforce shop floor accountability, KPIs, and standard work practices
* Maintain a safe, compliant, and disciplined manufacturing environment
* Support new product introductions and prototype builds with a strong understanding of machining constraints
* Overseeing multiple departments withing the manufacturing space.

Qualifications:

* 5+ years of progressive manufacturing experience, with clear growth from hands-on machining into leadership
* Strong CNC background required (setup, programming, and/or machining experience with mills, lathes, EDM)
* Prior experience in roles such as Machine Shop Manager, Manufacturing Manager, or Plant Manager
* Proven ability to lead teams in a high-precision, tight-tolerance environment
* Deep understanding of machining processes, tooling, fixturing, and production workflows
* Experience driving continuous improvement on the shop floor (Lean, process optimization, etc.)
* Comfortable being hands-on and highly visible in daily operations, not just managing from an office
* Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to develop talent from within
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field preferred, but equivalent hands-on experience strongly valued

Physical and Work Environment Requirements: 
This position is based in a manufacturing environment and may require the following over extended periods of time up to a full 8-hour work shift (excluding lunch and breaks): stand, walk, sit, squat or bend, kneel and rise, lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to — and occasionally exceeding — 50 pounds, view a computer or other digital screen, work on a computer, workstation or comparable system, and make accurate entries in such systems. Manual dexterity and fine motor skills are required for detailed assembly and precision work. Work may take place in areas with varying temperatures or no climate control, varying noise levels, and production equipment in motion. Proper personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn in designated areas at all times as required by company policy. Reasonable accommodations may be available to enable individuals with disabilities but are always subject to safety concerns for the employee and all team members. Employer may require a physical assessment of the candidate’s ability to perform these tasks as a condition of an offer letter. Any assessment will be performed by a third party vendor and will be reported on a pass/fail basis with no other medical information conveyed to employer.

*Equal Opportunity Employer:* 
*Gwynedd Manufacturing is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

*Note: This job description reflects general duties and responsibilities and is not intended to be an exhaustive list. Management may modify or assign other responsibilities as needed.*

new_roles.title: Senior Manager Operational Area Quality (Hybrid)
new_roles.description:
**Job Description**

**General/Position Summary**

 

The Quality Assurance Senior Operational Manager is recognized as an expert internally in the principles and application of quality assurance and compliance. The Quality Snr Manager will provide QA support of manufacturing operations, analytical laboratory operations and materials management for the external manufacture of Cell & Genetic Therapeutic programs. This role will drive, review & support activities related to product disposition including review of batch data, batch records, deviations, in-process data, EM data, QC release testing and other quality systems documentation.

 

**Key Duties & Responsibilities**

* Responsible for quality support of Vertex Cell and Gene Therapy manufacturing operations across all phases of development, support of analytical laboratory, materials management and manufacturing operations.

* Responsible for GMP batch disposition activities including review and approval of batch records, deviations, in-process data, EM data, QC release testing, materials review board and other quality activities as applicable to determine acceptability of product disposition.

* Partner with External CDMOs

* Provide QA support of change controls, process and OOS investigations, and associated CAPAs.

* Responsible for approval of COAs and product labelling.

* Support review and approval of manufacturing documents such as technical and analytical protocols/reports

* Support technical transfer, and process performance qualification activities.

* Responsible for identifying compliance risks and gaps for GMP processes and supporting implementation of mitigating controls

* Support audit and inspection readiness activities.

* Act as a trusted advisor by providing compliance guidance through collaborative review and partnering with business stakeholders and contract manufacturers.

* Support the vendor management process including the creation and review of Quality Agreements with suppliers.

* Assist with addressing product complaints

* Maintain periodic batch record metrics and assists department with routine/quarterly Quality System data review metrics and reporting

* Execute improvements to QA operations procedure.

* Participate/ lead Cell & Genetic Program and Quality projects and drive continuous improvement activities.

new_roles.title: Director of Pharmacy Operations, Quality and Compliance
new_roles.description:
#### **Director of Pharmacy Operations, Quality & Compliance**

ProCompounding Pharmacy is seeking an experienced pharmacist to provide leadership across pharmacy operations, quality systems, regulatory compliance, and sterile and nonsterile compounding.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership position for someone who understands both the technical and operational demands of a growing 503A compounding pharmacy. The successful candidate will help strengthen our pharmacy infrastructure, develop our people, maintain regulatory readiness, and build practical systems that support quality, consistency, and continued growth.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **The Director of Pharmacy Operations, Quality and Compliance will:**

* Provide leadership and oversight for pharmacy operations, quality, and regulatory compliance.
* Support sterile and nonsterile compounding operations and ensure alignment with applicable standards and regulations.
* Maintain and continuously improve the pharmacy's quality management systems.
* Oversee compliance with USP 795, 797, and 800 requirements.
* Lead preparation for regulatory inspections, accreditation surveys, and internal quality reviews.
* Manage investigations, deviations, rootcause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and related quality initiatives.
* Develop practical policies, procedures, and operating systems that improve consistency and accountability.
* Coach, develop, and support pharmacy team members and emerging leaders.
* Partner with ownership and leadership on operational priorities, risk management, and growth initiatives.
* Monitor regulatory developments and help ensure compliance across multiple states.

#### **Ideal Background**

#### **Strong candidates will bring:**

* Pharmacist licensure and significant experience within a 503A compounding pharmacy.
* Leadership experience involving pharmacy operations, quality, compliance, or staff management.
* Experience with both sterile and nonsterile compounding strongly preferred.
* Board Certification in Sterile Compounding Pharmacy (BCSCP) preferred.
* Working knowledge of USP 795, 797, and 800.
* Experience with inspections, accreditation, investigations, CAPA processes, and quality improvement.
* The ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical operating processes.
* Strong leadership, communication, documentation, and problemsolving skills.
* Experience working within a multistate pharmacy environment.

Experience in 503B outsourcing facilities, pharmaceutical manufacturing, or cGMP environments would be an additional advantage.

Multistate pharmacist licensure is not required.

#### **The Opportunity**

ProCompounding is a growing organization where senior leaders remain close to the work. This position is well suited for someone who enjoys building systems, solving problems, developing people, and taking ownership rather than operating within a highly layered corporate structure.

We are open to qualified candidates nationally and are willing to discuss relocation for the right individual. Experienced professionals who are ready to expand their leadership responsibilities are encouraged to apply.

#### **About ProCompounding Pharmacy**

MISSION: At ProCompounding Pharmacy, we provide personalized medications tailored to meet each individual's specific health requirements. With a commitment to excellence, integrity, and innovation, we stand at the forefront of pharmaceutical compounding, bridging the gap between traditional pharmacy and cutting-edge healthcare solutions. OUR SERVICES: We specialize in compounding services, including: \* Hormone Replacement Therapy \* Pediatric Compounding \* Veterinary Compounding \* Dermatology and Wound Care \* Pain Management \* Dental Compounding \* Over the counter supplements Each service is conducted with the highest standards, using pharmaceutical-grade ingredients and state-of-the-art compounding techniques. Our pharmacists work closely with healthcare providers to develop formulations that address our patients' precise needs.

new_roles.title: Sr Manager, Quality Assurance Engineering (Hybrid - Acton, MA)
new_roles.description:
Job Summary

This role is responsible for leading quality operations within a manufacturing plant, ensuring products and processes meet regulatory, company, and customer quality standards. The position manages quality systems, quality control personnel, supplier quality performance, product release activities, and compliance with FDA and ISO requirements while supporting both ongoing production and new product introductions. The Quality Manager works closely with manufacturing, engineering, suppliers, and corporate teams to drive continuous improvement, investigate and resolve quality issues through root cause analysis, oversee audits and inspections, develop quality training programs, and establish key performance metrics. Candidates should have a bachelor's degree in a technical field, experience in an FDA-regulated industry, strong knowledge of quality systems and statistical methods, and a proven ability to lead teams and drive positive change.



Position Overview:
 
Manages manufacturing plant quality programs, processes, activities, and Responsibilities: supporting current operations and new product introductions. Manages quality control personnel in the execution of their quality related duties. Interacts with other manufacturing departments (production, maintenance, engineering etc.) as well as with HQ support personnel, suppliers and other external parties on issues related to quality.
 
 
Responsibilities:
 

* Establish and maintain a manufacturing Quality Management System and team that contributes to outstanding customer service and promotes the highest standards for product quality.
* Plans, organizes, directs and reports on all quality assurance engineering related activities such as product components, manufacturing in-process controls, product release.
* Ensure incoming parts/materials are within specification and all required documents are complete and accurate.
* Identify QC test procedures and equipment required to maintain high product quality.
* Ensure suppliers are performing tolerance/specification testing, utilizing Insulet’s prescribed test methods, procedures and equipment.
* Make sure released product meets specifications and predetermined criteria to ensure Pod and sub assembly manufacturing is in compliance and control through lot Qualification process and procedures.
* Lead and execute root cause analysis to determine failure causes and implement failure reduction and elimination strategies.
* Suggest methods for improving product quality, design, or manufacturing processes
* Develop and/or manage quality programs and training, complete with tools and processes that support an operational excellence environment and ensure compliance with all company and Federal audit requirements.
* Establish key quality KPI’s and score carding/tracking mechanisms to ensure continuous improvement.
* Manage existing and create new, if necessary, quality gates to ensure Incoming Quality Assurance, Pod and sub assembly manufacturing are in compliance and control.
* Ensure plant policies and procedures are in compliance with all FDA regulations.
* Engage with suppliers and supplier development group in monitoring supplier quality performance.
* Serve as a team member and leader to provide quality expertise to other manufacturing functional teams.
* Work cross functionally with HQ and field personnel to promote understanding and cooperation for the quality agenda.
* Lead all quality and regulatory inspections and audits, as well as the completion of all action items in a timely manner.
* Maintain all internal and external quality documents and prepare required reports in a timely manner.
* Develop and implement training programs and best practices required to maintain high-quality standards.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

 
Education and Experience:
 
Minimum Requirements:
 

* BS degree in engineering, a technical or scientific discipline; and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in the FDA regulated environment.
* Experience in Quality in an FDA regulated industry.

 
Preferred Skills and Competencies:
 

* Have knowledge, experience and understanding of the tenets of Six Sigma Process and other statistical analysis tools (SPC) required to maintain high standards. Six Sigma black belt preferred.
* Have knowledge and understanding of ISO programs.
* High proficiency with software that is centered on process management and statistical data analysis.
* Successful experience in factory level quality, production and / or maintenance management.
* Effective verbal and excellent technical writing skills.
* Ability to communicate at multiple levels of an organization.
* Ability to organize and judge priorities.
* Excels at generating and maintaining organized and accurate records.
* Knowledge of Quality principles using statistics and SPC tools.
* PC skill, word processing, spreadsheet, database.
* Able to work effectively in a high-stress, high-energy environment.
* Able to make effective decisions quickly based on vague or imperfect information.
* Great interpersonal skills.
* Track record of leading positive change.

*NOTE: This position is eligible for hybrid working arrangements (requires on-site work from an Insulet office). #LI-Hybrid*

Additional Information:

Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD), headquartered in Massachusetts, is an innovative medical device company dedicated to simplifying life for people with diabetes and other conditions through its Omnipod product platform. The Omnipod Insulin Management System provides a unique alternative to traditional insulin delivery methods. With its simple, wearable design, the tubeless disposable Pod provides up to three days of non-stop insulin delivery, without the need to see or handle a needle. Insulet’s flagship innovation, the Omnipod 5 Automated Insulin Delivery System, integrates with a continuous glucose monitor to manage blood sugar with no multiple daily injections, zero fingersticks, and can be controlled by a compatible personal smartphone in the U.S. or by the Omnipod 5 Controller. Insulet also leverages the unique design of its Pod by tailoring its Omnipod technology platform for the delivery of non-insulin subcutaneous drugs across other therapeutic areas. For more information, please visit insulet.com and omnipod.com.
 
 
We are looking for highly motivated, performance-driven individuals to be a part of our expanding team. We do this by hiring amazing people guided by shared values who exceed customer expectations. Our continued success depends on it!

At Insulet Corporation all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

( Know Your Rights )

new_roles.title: Sr. Director, Infrastructure and Operations
new_roles.description:
**J****ob Title:** Sr. Director, Infrastructure and Operations

**Group:** Information Technology

**Location:** Hybrid

**Reports To**: Chief Information Officer

ASME is seeking a **Sr. Director, Infrastructure and Operations** to join our IT group. The Sr. Director will lead the strategy, architecture, engineering, and operations of ASME's infrastructure, telecommunications, networks, help desk, and related security capabilities.

This role will ensure secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective technology services while advancing DevOps practices, business continuity, disaster recovery, and responsible implementation of artificial intelligence across ASME's technology stack.

The position partners closely with Architecture and Applications, Security, the Project Management Office, and business leaders to support current operations and future enterprise needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the strategy, architecture, engineering, and day-to-day operations of ASME infrastructure, cloud, network, telecommunications, endpoint, help desk, and production platforms.
* Lead major infrastructure initiatives, establish policies and standards, strengthen cross-functional and vendor partnerships, and coach and develop a high-performing, customer-focused Technology team.
* Design and implement secure, compliant, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective infrastructure systems that integrate effectively with current applications and meet enterprise requirements.
* Determine current and future infrastructure needs, develop capital and expense budgets, and oversee vendors, service-level agreements, and key performance indicators.
* Build and continuously improve DevOps practices, methodologies, and tools that support continuous integration and continuous delivery.
* Direct business continuity, disaster recovery, institutional risk management, infrastructure documentation, and compliance with applicable security and data requirements, including PCI-DSS.
* Identify and implement emerging AI capabilities for Infrastructure and Operations, including AIOps, AI-enabled platform engineering, AI agents, and automation platforms, with appropriate governance, monitoring, security, lifecycle management, and risk controls.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology or a related field, or equivalent additional experience; master's degree is a plus.
* Minimum of 8 years of relevant technical and leadership experience in infrastructure and operations.
* Extensive experience designing, implementing, and managing infrastructure, cloud, network, telecommunications, endpoint, virtualization, storage, recovery, and support environments, including Microsoft Azure.
* Experience with endpoint management and asset lifecycle solutions such as Microsoft Intune, PDQ, or Jamf, and with secure network architecture and protocols such as SASE; Cato experience is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated leadership experience in security, crisis management, business continuity, disaster recovery, risk management, and technology compliance.
* Experience applying project management frameworks to large-scale technology initiatives and communicating complex technical topics clearly to senior and executive leaders.
* Experience with emerging AI technologies, including Microsoft Copilot and private large language models, and the ability to build strong internal and external relationships.
* Proven experience leading, coaching, and developing high-performing technical teams.
* Demonstrated ability to establish clear standards, strengthen accountability, and build a customer-focused culture of operational excellence.
* Demonstrated success leading organizational change and operational improvement initiatives.

**Work Arrangement**

This role is eligible for a hybrid work arrangement and will be based in either our New York or New Jersey office locations, subject to ASME's hybrid-work policies and business requirements. Periodic business travel will be required, including but not limited to ASME Offices which are currently located in NYC, NJ, DC, TX.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The New York Metro annual base salary range for this position is $210,000–$225,000 per year. The actual compensation offered will be determined based on factors including qualifications, experience, skills, geographic location, and internal equity.

This position will also be eligible to participate in ASME's annual incentive bonus program, subject to the applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Additionally, ASME offers eligible employees a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage; health savings and flexible spending account options; life and disability insurance; a 401(k) retirement plan; paid vacation and safe and sick leave; paid holidays; parental leave; employee assistance and wellness programs; and professional-development opportunities. Eligibility and benefit levels vary based on employment status and the terms of the applicable plans. For additional information, please visit ASME's Benefits page.

**About ASME**

ASME helps the global engineering community develop solutions to real-world challenges. Founded in 1880 as The American Society of Mechanical Engineers, ASME is a nonprofit professional organization that enables collaboration, knowledge sharing, and skill development across all engineering disciplines, while promoting the vital role of the engineer in society. ASME codes and standards, publications, conferences, continuing education, and professional development programs provide a foundation for advancing technical knowledge and a safer world. From college students and early-career engineers to project managers, corporate executives, researchers, and academic leaders, ASME's members are as diverse as the engineering community itself.

ASME is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. At ASME, we nurture an inclusive environment, and we encourage, support, and celebrate diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, citizenship status, disability, or protected veteran, military status, or any other basis protected by law.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity policy pertains to every aspect of an individual’s relationship with the organization, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, compensation, benefits, training and development, promotion, programs, and all other terms and conditions of employment.

Only those candidates selected for further consideration will be contacted.

new_roles.title: Director, FP&A - Enterprise Operations
new_roles.description:
Company Overview:

**Why Choose Us?**
------------------

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging that supports multiple industries including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors. Novolex manufacturing and sourcing expertise spans a diverse range of substrates including resin, paper, molded fiber, aluminum and more. We provide customers a broad array of stock and customized solutions with 120 product categories, 250 brands and over 39,000 SKUs.

**Our Sustainability Commitment**
---------------------------------

The Novolex sustainability vision is built upon three pillars: our products, our operations and our people. Each is critically important to our growth and future as a business. These pillars form the foundation of our company-wide commitment to sustainability, helping us achieve our ambitious goals through our wide-ranging initiatives.

Job Description:

The Director of Financial Planning & Analysis is a key leadership role responsible for financial planning, forecasting, reporting and analysis used to identify risks and opportunities across the business. The successful candidate will build strategic partnerships across business units and functional teams that will lead to improved processes and transparency around key operating metrics. This is a key member of the Enterprise Operations function, who will support senior leaders, including COO and Operations staff, to drive organizational transformation and ensure company financial objectives are met

**How You’ll Perform the Role**

 

* Oversee and coordinate monthly finance processes, resulting in added visibility and a clear understanding of business trends and overall financial outlook
* Oversee and directly guide annual Enterprise Operations budgeting process
* Responsible for management reporting, ensuring desired level of accuracy and timeliness is met
* Lead Capital Expenditure process, driving strong financial governance, and ensure effectiveness of capital deployment in generating favorable business outcomes
* Develop and implement tools and/or processes to establish forecasting, budgeting, reporting within function.
* Identify appropriate KPIs and reporting across the different levels of the organization to measure productivity, capital expenditure, and other operational metrics
* Conduct ad-hoc analyses with the ability to clearly summarize and present findings to executive leadership team members
* Partner across Operations, Engineering, Accounting and all necessary functions to drive business results and assure connectivity
* Connect with BU CFOs, Operations VPs, and Operations Finance to assure efficiencies and align processes

**What We Need From You**

 

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related Business field
* 10+ years of experience
* Experience leading teams both directly, indirectly, and leading projects cross-functionally

* Excellent business partnership skills with a record of collaborating across functions and levels within an organization to accomplish team goals
* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Strategic thinking, ability to simplify the complex, make/drive decisions, and adapt to changing environment

* Proven analytical and financial skills, demonstrated strong economic thinking
* Clearly understand integrated financial systems and the Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Access, Word, PowerPoint)
* Travel approximately 10% or less

#LI-Hybrid

Company Benefits:

**What You'll Get From Us**
---------------------------

### **Benefits**

With safety as our top priority and a commitment to employee well-being an important focus, we offer comprehensive and competitive benefits that include medical, dental and vision insurance as well as a variety of other well-being resources focused on mental, physical and financial health. Specific benefits and well-being programs may vary depending on where you work.

### **Community Engagement**

At Novolex, giving back to the local communities that support us is important. Our Focused Giving Program prioritizes support for organizations whose missions promote sustainability initiatives or address food and hunger needs. We also encourage facility level support of activities in the communities where our employees live and work.

### **Training and Development**

We offer constant opportunities for advancement. From skills development to advanced education programs, training and development programs and courses are available through MyLearning. Programs include company and industry training curricula, support for formal education through the Tuition Reimbursement Program (Non-Union), and a Learning Management System that supports and enhances employee skills at all levels of the organization.

Novolex is committed to providing equal employment opportunity in all employment practices, including but not limited to selection, hiring, promotion, transfer, and compensation to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, handicap or disability, genetics, citizenship status, service member or veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law. Any individual who, because of his or her disability, needs an accommodation in connection with an aspect of the Company's application process should contact myHRservices@novolex.com.

new_roles.title: Director, Program Operations
new_roles.description:
In this role, the Director of Program Operations leads a team of Operations Program Managers (OPM) and Material Program Managers (MPM) responsible for the operational elements of program execution within Mercury's IPS business unit. This role serves as the primary conduit between the line of business and operational teams, ensuring seamless coordination across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and growth functions.

You will be responsible for developing and executing operational program plans for critical programs, overall ownership of operational program performance, and internal communication of customer requirements affecting operational execution.

The Director of Program Operations will support proposals by providing accurate basis of cost estimates, focusing on supply chain material costs in addition to manufacturing labor costs. This work will be performed in conjunction with factory operations, supply chain, and engineering functions. Candidates must have excellent written and oral communications skills to influence across multiple functions and communicate effectively with external partners.

This role is on site at one of the following Mercury facilities: **Torrance, CA**

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of OPMs and MPMs accountable for operational aspects of program life cycle from proposal, development, production, sustainment, & delivery.
* Serve as the primary liaison between the line of business and operations, communicating customer requirements that affect manufacturing and supply chain execution.
* Responsible for meeting the financial objectives of the business unit, including the management of Estimate at Completion (EACs) specific to operations labor and material content.
* Oversee supply chain and manufacturing milestones to ensure compliance with contract baseline.
* Monitor program risks and opportunities, including obsolescence management, reporting, and improvement actions.
* Support and present operations metrics and data through program reviews (both internal and external) to Mercury and customer leadership.
* Champion efforts to meet readiness requirements throughout an NPI stage-gate process.
* Change leader, helping to drive Mercury's strategy, structure, and values.
* Strategic thinking coupled with ROI / business case development.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree
* Typically requires 10+ years prior relevant experience in functional areas of Supply Chain, Operations (including Production Control), Program Management, or technical Project Management.
* Strong financial acumen with experience providing input into and reviewing EACs, along with development of business cases.
* Experience in review and understanding of Statements of Work (SOW) and project requirements (technical and commercial).
* Strong analytical skills, problem‑solving capabilities, and attention to detail.
* Experience developing and mentoring high‑performing teams.
* Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation), leadership abilities, and the ability to work in an IPT environment.
* The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* A self-starter, capable of achieving organizational and program objectives, and able to interface with all levels of internal management and external stakeholders.
* Ability to succeed in fast paced, developmental environment.
* Excellent time management skills and the ability to assign the appropriate priorities to the many tasks that need to be performed.
* Knowledge of US Government acquisition laws and regulations (FAR).
* Proficiency in ERP/MRP business systems.
* Knowledge of Mercury-type products.

#LI-RL1

Mercury Systems is a technology company that makes the world a safer, more secure place. From silicon to system scale, Mercury enables customers to accelerate innovation and turn data into decision superiority. Headquartered in Andover, Massachusetts, Mercury employs more than 2,300 people in 24 locations worldwide. To learn more, visit mrcy.com

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager, Quality
new_roles.description:
At Bloom Energy, our vision for a world powered by clean, reliable, and affordable energy is more than just a dream—we’re making it reality.

 

For over two decades, we’ve been at the forefront of the global energy transition, pioneering solutions that empower critical industries to thrive in a rapidly digitizing, energy-intensive world. From revolutionizing power for AI-driven data centers to ensuring resilience for hospitals, electric grids, manufacturing facilities, and utilities, our solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and solid oxide electrolyzer (SOEC) technologies are redefining what’s possible by delivering energy abundance for all. With more than 30,000 fuel cell modules deployed worldwide, we are the trusted partner for Fortune 100 companies and innovators alike. Our cutting-edge solutions enable unparalleled “time-to-power” capabilities, reliability, and sustainability, ensuring our customers remain ahead in a world where soaring energy demand and intensifying energy scarcity are rapidly becoming the new norm.

At Bloom, we thrive on collaboration, bold thinking, and relentless innovation. We believe that, together, we can create a brighter, more sustainable future while tackling the most pressing challenges of the 21st century.

 

We are looking for a S **r. Manager, Quality** to join our team in one of today’s most exciting technologies. This role will report to **Director of Quality** and based in **Newark, Delaware. This is a fully on-site, in office role 5 days a week** .

 

**Role and Responsibilities:**

* Ensure 100% Quality assurance at the Skid line manufacturing through inspection, testing, and sub-component testing/inspection. Assist in hiring personnel needed to support this effort.

* Partner with Install Quality team (field) to understand real time (daily) what items are escaping the plant and instituting immediate mitigation plans including addressing any inventory in the pipeline not yet installed.

* Implement permanent corrective actions working with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply chain, or SQE as per relevance on each issue.

* Provide quality input into the new equipment being purchased for the scaling of Delaware manufacturing. Include inputs for quality assurance into equipment design, and verification of process steps. Understand and provide input into the planned operation, what can be bypassed, maintenance plans, calibration or drift of the equipment, automation that can fail and be undetected leading to quality escapes.

* Participate and understand results from testing in the plant; Functional test, Tommy test, FIT, etc. Drive pareto of failures to help cross functional problem solving of test failures.

* Implement a 100% functional test (new) on skid final product assembly; electrical continuity, communications integrity, piping assurance, start up simulation, etc. to assure 100% QA prior to shipping to customer.

* Ensure skid components and systems have latest FW revision prior to shipping to the W/H, or out of W/H to field.

* Work with CIG and Manufacturing Engr, and NPI to implement workload being removed from the customer install side and being moved into skid assembly. Provide oversight to ensure best quality achievement; ensure work instructions are clear, operators trained, workstations have proper tools, and judgement criteria.

* Collaborate with Supplier Quality / Suppliers to achieve zero-defect flow (“dock-to-stock”) for all purchased, contract manufacture parts, materials, and Bloom Energy manufactured parts.

* Drive component and design failures back to the earliest point of detection in the process.

* Ensure manufacturing process have Control plans with CTQ, and POA built in to each station.

* Work collaboratively with Design teams to DFM, through a “registration system”, and Pokeyoke assembly methods for highest quality assurance.

* Drive test excellence in the manufacturing plan to ensure that equipment and test stations are certified with robust qualification programs, that are documented and controlled for changes with proper accuracy and gage R&R techniques.

* Drive yield task forces to achieve company wide targets at each manufacturing point under this scope, with cross functional teams driving top pareto issues to RCCA.

* Ensure early engagement with the product engineering team to teach and perform early stage risk assessments (DFMEA et.al.)

* Design for manufacturability and reliability improvements during the early design stages of product development.

* Work with Engineering NPI and the manufacturing engineering teams to perform PFMEA, write work instructions, and establish quality check-points to guarantee zero-defect quality in production.

* Develop and implement formal, comprehensive process documentation including process flow diagrams, Process FMEAs, process control plans, operations method Sheets, manufacturing quality charts (MQCs) and etc.

* Lead critical problem solving task forces with emphasis on cross functional inputs, accountability, time to RCCA, and ensurance of mitigation of inventory, or field units at risk.

* Troubleshoot product issues by reviewing engineering drawings and design requirements. Drive a rigorous resolution process for product quality, reliability and design issues.

* Perform data-driven root cause failure analyses for design, manufacturing, and administrative problems.

* Perform process audits to monitor, continuously improve, and sustain superior product quality.

* Demonstrate the ability to interface and work collaboratively across departments internally and with suppliers and customers, (including Purchasing, Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Marketing and Finance), while building strong and cooperative working relationships.

* Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) Reduction: Establish and govern site COPQ metrics (scrap, rework, sorting, and warranty risk); lead cross-functional yield-improvement blitzes targeting measurable cost reductions and scrap minimization.

* Process Capability & Zero-Defect Mentality: Drive process capability (C\_p / C\_{pk} \ge 1.33) across critical-to-quality (CTQ) operations (welding, brazing, ceramic stack assembly, plumbing/gas-delivery, and electrical integration).

 

**Skills and Experience:**

* More than 10 years of increasing responsibility in the areas of Quality, and Manufacturing .

* Experience implementing company-wide ISO 9001 procedures and TS16949 standards and related process documentation. Possess working knowledge of process capability and control requirements, methods and systems.

* Demonstrated track record of building, restructuring, or significantly scaling a manufacturing quality team during rapid production ramp-up

* Proven successful application of multi-discipline engineering problem solving techniques.

* Understand the critical elements of modern Manufacturing Statistical Process Control, (e.g., practical working knowledge and experience with SPC, Process Capability, Cp, Cpk, etc.)

* Understand the critical elements of modern Reliability Engineering, (e.g., MCF, MTBF, MTT, etc.)

* Certification in a recognized problem-solving methodology such as six-sigma Black Belt, 8D, or Global Problem Solving.

* Strong verbal/active listening/written communications.

* Demonstrate planning and leadership skills.

* Expert with metrology, calibration, and Gage R & R’s.

* Ability to train in Quality System Auditing.

* Fluent in product phase-gate, NPI and technology transfer.

* Expertise in applying PPAP, First Article Inspections (FAI) and Reports).

* Strong critical thinking, analytical skills, and problem solving.

* Ability to effectively work within a very intense, dynamic, fast-paced, and demanding work environment.

* Familiarity with industry codes and quality standards applicable to clean power systems (ISO 9001:2015 required; working knowledge of ASME, NFPA, or UL standards preferred).

* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality / Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE) and ASQ Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE) alongside CQE and Six Sigma Black Belt.

* Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Suite and statistical software.

* Possess a passion for excellence.

* Unrestricted willingness to travel to all regions. Travel may be up to 25% of time.

* BS, MS or PhD in Mechanical/Material Science/Chemical/Electrical/Systems Engineering.

* Direct experience managing high-temperature fluidics/gas delivery, welding/brazing, ceramic integration, power electronics, or structural enclosures is a strong plus.

 

Bloom Energy is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We are committed to compliance with all applicable laws providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified applicants, will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability. Bloom Energy makes reasonable accommodations, consistent with applicable laws, for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified applicant or employee with a disability, who can perform the essential job functions, unless undue hardship would result.

 

At Bloom Energy, we are committed to supporting the well-being of our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits package for eligible employees includes competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans with a large employer contribution, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match, generous Mental Health Support services, Legal services, virtual Physical Therapy access, and Fertility & Family Forming benefits.

Bloom Energy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The total compensation for this position includes standard company benefits and is based on various factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience.

**Salary Ranges:**
==================

$149,300.00 - $214,700.00

new_roles.description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world.A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

**Job Summary**
---------------





**General Purpose** **:**

Responsible for leading and developing a team of process engineers and technicians responsible for SMT manufacturing processes and continuous improvement. Provides technical and organizational leadership to establish and improve manufacturing process capabilities, increase capacity and throughput, reduce cost, improve quality and reliability, and support successful introduction of new products. Partners closely with Operations, Quality, Product Engineering, NPI, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and other functional teams to ensure manufacturing processes meet customer, quality, delivery, cost, and capacity requirements.

**Principal Accountabilities** **:**

* Lead, coach, develop, and manage a team of process engineers and technicians supporting SMT manufacturing, including board printing, SPI, pick and place, reflow, AOI, X-ray, and other back-end operations, excluding Box Assembly.

* Establish clear goals, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans for engineering team members. Provide regular coaching, feedback, performance management, and career development.

* Establish, maintain, and continuously improve process capabilities to achieve required levels of quality, reliability, throughput, capacity, and cost.

* Develop and maintain process documentation, including work instructions, PFMEA, Control Plans, process specifications, and other applicable manufacturing documentation.

* Lead engineering efforts to identify and eliminate process variation, defects, scrap, rework, downtime, and other sources of manufacturing inefficiency.

* Use data-driven problem-solving and appropriate engineering methodologies, including statistical analysis, SPC, DOE, root-cause analysis, and structured corrective action, to resolve complex manufacturing issues.

* Develop and maintain appropriate engineering and manufacturing performance metrics.

OEE, scrap, and yield to name a few

* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, collaboration, problem solving, and ownership within the engineering organization.

* Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, tools, standards, and best practices and share lessons learned across the organization.

* Ensure engineering activities comply with applicable safety, environmental, quality-system, regulatory, customer, and company requirements.

* Build effective relationships with internal and external customers, suppliers, equipment manufacturers, and other technical partners as required.

* Communicate engineering priorities, project status, risks, resource requirements, and recommendations effectively to site and senior leadership.

* Implement appropriate HR strategies and actions to recruit, retain, develop, and motivate a qualified and high-performing engineering workforce.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

**EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE:**

Requires a bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience and training. A Master's or MBA degree is a plus but not required.

Typically requires **9 years** of engineering experience, including experience leading or supervising engineering personnel. Experience in high-volume electronics manufacturing and SMT processes is strongly preferred.

 

**KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / ABILITIES:**

* Demonstrated functional, technical, and people-management skills, with the ability to lead engineers and technicians in a manufacturing environment.

* Strong knowledge of SMT manufacturing processes, including solder paste printing, SPI, pick and place, reflow, AOI, X-ray, and related manufacturing processes.

* Demonstrated understanding of process capability, statistical process control, root-cause analysis, DOE, PFMEA, Control Plans, and structured continuous improvement methodologies.

* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence decisions across Engineering, Operations, Quality, NPI, Product Engineering, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and other functions.

* Ability to establish priorities, allocate resources, manage competing projects, and make sound engineering and business decisions.

* Demonstrated ability to use manufacturing and engineering data to identify problems, establish facts, determine root causes, and drive measurable improvements.

* Strong understanding of manufacturing economics, including cost reduction, capacity, throughput, capital investment, and return on investment.

* Demonstrated ability to develop, coach, and retain engineering talent and build a high-performing team.

* Strong interpersonal, communication, presentation, and organizational skills.

* Ability to communicate complex technical information effectively to engineers, technicians, operations personnel, customers, and senior management.

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex technical, engineering, financial, and business documents.

* Ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries and complaints and resolve complex issues using sound judgment and appropriate communication.

* Ability to make effective and persuasive presentations regarding technical recommendations, business cases, project status, and complex engineering issues.

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts including probability, statistical inference, process capability, and statistical analysis and apply them to practical manufacturing situations.

* Ability to define problems, collect and analyze data, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, and develop practical solutions.

* Demonstrated proficiency with common engineering and business software, including word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, data analysis, and other applicable manufacturing/engineering systems.

* Working knowledge of applicable employment laws, company policies, and HR practices.

 

JT05

AA01

LB34

 
 

**What you'll receive for the great work you provide:**

* Full range of medical, dental, and vision plans
* Life Insurance
* Short-term and Long-term Disability
* Matching 401(k) Contributions
* Vacation and Paid Sick Time
* Tuition Reimbursement

new_roles.title: Director, Strategy & Operations
new_roles.description:
**The Problem**

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

**Who We Are**

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation delivering specialty outpatient care for people with severe mental illness through high-acuity, in-person clinics nationwide.

Our integrated model brings psychiatry, therapy, primary care, dietitians, and community support together under one roof. Leading health systems—including **New York-Presbyterian, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Novant Health, and CommonSpirit**—collaborate with us to expand this level of care.

Alongside care delivery, we are building the science and technology the field has long lacked—proprietary clinical protocols, novel measurement, and an AI-driven data platform designed for severe mental illness.

The impact: fewer hospitalizations, greater stability, and more people living meaningful lives in their communities.

**The Team**

We are clinicians, operators, technologists, and scientists who chose Amae because the problem is hard and the stakes are real. We are not interested in incremental improvements to a broken system—we are redefining it.

Every function—finance, product, people, growth, technology—exists to serve one goal: better outcomes for the people we care for.

**The Role**

Amae Health is seeking a strategic and execution-oriented **Director of Growth & Operations** to lead market expansion and operational performance across our care delivery ecosystem. This leader will sit at the intersection of market growth, community partnerships, and operational excellence. This role is based in SF Bay Area, in-person 5 days/week in Cow Hollow.

**What You'll Work On**

* Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve day-to-day care delivery: new market launches, care model design, referral conversion, and operational scalability
* Build and implement market playbooks, workflows, and performance frameworks that enable consistent execution across locations
* Use data and frontline feedback to identify bottlenecks, then build and drive improvement initiatives with clear owners and measurable outcomes
* Lead cross-functional workstreams across clinical, ops, and product; manage alignment, communication, and rollout
* Build the systems and SOPs that turn one-off solutions into scalable standards

**What You'll Bring**

* 7+ years of experience in strategy, operations, or growth roles at a venture-backed startup, consulting firm, or healthcare company
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence clinical and executive stakeholders
* Experience in commercially-oriented work: market expansion, partnership operations, or growth initiatives
* Strong analytical and operational mindset with ability to translate strategy into execution
* Startup experience strongly preferred—you've navigated ambiguity and figured things out without a playbook
* Collaborative and high-EQ; you know how to move cross-functional teams without formal authority
* Interest in healthcare or behavioral health; you care about the mission
* Based in SF Bay Area; able to work in-person 5 days/week in Cow Hollow

**What We're Building**

Most healthcare companies ask you to optimize an existing system. We're building one that has never existed.

* A national care model designed for the highest-acuity patients in behavioral health.
* Precision medicine for severe mental illness, using multimodal clinical, behavioral, and social data to personalize treatment.
* A clinical operating system that integrates longitudinal data, real-time patient signals, and purpose-built tools into a single decision layer.
* New science and measurement frameworks to define what real outcomes look like in SMI.
* A health-system partnership model proving coordinated SMI care can work at scale.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Amae Health is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. **Base salary range for this role is $165,000–$200,000 per year**, adjusted to market cost; the compensation package may include equity. Total compensation includes comprehensive medical/dental/vision, unlimited PTO, parental leave, and programs built around employee well-being. We'll share specifics during the interview process.

*Amae Health is building the care platform, the precision medicine, and the frontier science that severe mental illness has never had. If you want to be part of creating something this hard and this important, something that has never been done, we'd like to talk.*

**What We Value**

* **We center care in all we do.** Empathy is not a brand value. It's how we make clinical decisions, build products, and treat each other.
* **We challenge convention.** The existing system is the problem. We question it, we test alternatives, and we move with urgency when something works.
* **We take the work seriously, not ourselves.** High standards and humanity are not in tension. We hold a hard bar for quality while leaving room for humor and levity.
* **Your job isn't done until the job is done.** We close gaps, we follow through, and we don't hide behind titles or org charts.
* **We win together and fail together.** We own outcomes as a team. We learn fast. We don't do blame.
* **We hustle with humility.** Speed matters. So does integrity. We assume best intent and stay grounded in the mission.

new_roles.title: Revenue - Director of Special Projects and Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
**Company Description**

A best-in-class city that attracts best-in-class talent, Philadelphia is an incredible place to build a career. From our thriving arts scene and rich history to our culture of passion and grit, there are countless reasons to love living and working here. With a workforce of over 30,000 people, and more than 1,000 different job categories, the City of Philadelphia offers boundless opportunities to make an impact.

As an employer, the City of Philadelphia values inclusion, integrity, innovation, empowerment, and hard work above all else. We offer a vibrant work environment, comprehensive health care and benefits, and the experience you need to grow and excel. If you’re interested in working with a passionate team of people who care about the future of Philadelphia, start here.

***What we offer***

* **Impact** - The work you do here matters to millions.
* **Growth** - Philadelphia is growing, why not grow with it?
* **Diversity & Inclusion** - Find a career in a place where everyone belongs.
* **Benefits** - We care about your well-being.

***Agency Description***

The mission of the Department of Revenue is to collect tax and non-tax revenue due to the City and tax revenue due to the School District of Philadelphia while providing service to customers that is fair and efficient and ensuring that the City provides services that the residents can see, touch, and feel. The Department’s revenue collections enable the Administration to invest in the Mayor’s strategic priorities, including housing, education, and making Philadelphia the safest, cleanest, and greenest big city in the nation with economic opportunity for everyone.

***Work-Life***

Working hours are generally 37.5 hours per week. Our team is full-time on office days.

 **Job Description**

The Continuous Improvement Director leads the Continuous Improvement pillar within the Revenue Strategic Transformation division. This role identifies, prioritizes, and delivers process improvement initiatives that increase operational efficiency, reduce waste, and improve the experience of both employees and the residents and businesses the department serves.

The CI Director brings a disciplined improvement practice to a large public organization: mapping how work actually flows, finding where it breaks down, and redesigning it in partnership with the units that own it. Success depends on facilitation, analytical rigor, and the ability to see how decisions in one part of the department create consequences in another.

The CI Director owns the improvement methodology, process mapping and redesign discipline, customer satisfaction measurement, documentation standards, and the training that builds continuous improvement capability across the department. The role leads a small team and is expected to develop that team, not simply directing its work.

The CI Director works in close partnership with the Executive Director, who provides strategic direction, and coordinates with the division's other pillars: Operations, Project Management, Change Management, and Innovation and Advanced Analytics.

***Essential Functions***

Continuous Improvement of Methodology and Execution

* Design and maintain the department's continuous improvement framework, applying Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, root cause analysis, and process redesign methods as appropriate to each initiative.
* Lead current-state process mapping across business units, documenting workflows, identifying waste, rework, and handoff failures, and designing future-state processes in partnership with the relevant unit.
* Lead improvement initiatives from intake through implementation, ensuring changes are measurable, sustainable, and owned by the business unit responsible for execution.
* Design and maintain controls and monitoring mechanisms so improvements are sustained and do not revert to prior practice.
* Apply design thinking to identify where a local improvement would create downstream burden elsewhere, and design accordingly.

2. Intake and Prioritization

* Capture improvement opportunities from business unit requests, performance data, customer feedback, staff suggestions, and strategic priorities.
* Apply a structured prioritization framework covering feasibility screening, scoring, and portfolio balancing to select initiatives that deliver the highest value relative to effort and risk.
* Operate the shared intake and routing protocol with the Project Management Office and the Innovation and Advanced Analytics unit, so that improvement requests, project requests, and pilot concepts follow one clear path.
* Maintain a portfolio tracker providing visibility into active, pipeline, and completed initiatives with documented outcomes.

3. Customer Satisfaction Measurement

* Own design, distribution, and analysis of customer satisfaction surveys, including the external survey of residents and businesses and the internal business unit survey.
* Produce and distribute monthly reports with trend analysis and actionable insight.
* Route improvement opportunities identified through customer feedback into the intake process.
* Coordinate with Communications on distribution and messaging, and with Innovation and Advanced Analytics on data integration and reporting.

4. Standards, Procedures, and Process Documentation

* Establish departmental standards for processing documentation so procedures, workflows, and operational guides are created and maintained consistently across units.
* Provide templates, frameworks, and guidance to business units documenting their own processes, with Continuous Improvement serving as the quality standard-setter.
* Maintain a central repository of documented processes accessible to leadership and business units.

5. Training, Culture, and Team Development

* Produce quarterly impact reports for the Executive Director documenting portfolio progress, results achieved, and lessons learned.
